jobs.description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐️ THE DATA TEAM

 - Being part of Alan's data team means you'll have a positive impact on people's health and wellbeing.

 - We create insights to help our colleagues focus on what is most impactful. 

 - We build features and tools powered by data that directly help our members. 

 - Examples include: 
   
   - going deep into health consumption patterns, 
   
   - understanding our product usage, 
   
   - creating visibility to help our sales team perform, 
   
   - automating how we reimburse our members, 
   
   - building products that help our members stay healthy... 

We also believe in having a full stack approach:

 - Each one of us contributes to all 3 aspects of the data spectrum (analytics, engineering, science). This encourages strong ownership and drives impact.

 - We own our infrastructure. We pride ourselves on a nimble data stack that gives us the flexibility we need. We're mainly using SQL, Python, R, Airflow, Snowflake, and Metabase. 

 - We build in-house tooling to organize our data and serve it to the rest of the company.



🎯 EXPECTED SKILLS AND ABILITIES


You would thrive at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

 - Passionate about owning ambitious problems and developing simple solutions for them

 - Demonstrated impact during a first successful experience.

 - Experience or willingness to grow in all 3 aspects of the data spectrum (analytics, engineering, science) -- being specialized in one of these areas is good too!

 - Proficient in SQL, Python and/or R- Setting a high standard of rigor and precision for yourself, interested in your craft

 - Great listening and communication skills

 - Humble, kind, collaborative, and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!)

 - Fluent and clear in English, both oral and written (no need to speak French!)



For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.




⚙️ IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.



If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐ THE ENGINEERING TEAM ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of interactions.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Want to know more? Read this article https://medium.com/alan/a-new-iteration-of-our-engineering-career-path-at-alan-f46f7b229b2d on our Engineering career path.




🛠️ THE STACK

Python/Flask, Typescript, React, React Native on the coding side. AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, Terraform/Terramate, Datadog, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions on the platform side, all in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.




🤖 THE INFRA CREW - WITHIN THE TECH FOUNDATIONS AREA

🎯 Mission:

 - Tech Foundations - enables product crews and creates the environment to thrive, combining world-class infrastructure, intuitive developer experience, exquisite operational excellence, and built-in security to make shipping exceptional products effortless.

 - Infra - is one of its crews. Its mission: operate and evolve the foundations Alan runs on (multi-cloud infrastructure, data platforms, observability, and the operational practices around them) so that product crews ship safely and quickly, members never feel the platform underneath, and the business can expand to new countries without re-inventing how we run.

🔭 Scope:

 1. Cloud foundations & multi-cloud architecture: own and evolve Alan’s cloud footprint, Infrastructure-as-Code stack (Terraform, Terramate), and the architectural decisions enabling international expansion.

 2. Data & application platforms: operate and evolve the foundations product crews build on: PostgreSQL/Aurora, our events pipeline, async workloads, and database migration tooling, without leaking complexity into product code.

 3. Reliability, observability & on-call: own Alan's platform uptime and latency SLOs end-to-end. Evolve our observability stack (Datadog), the incident response process (Incident.io http://Incident.io), and the shared on-call rotation across the area to keep it sustainable as we scale.

 4. Governance & compliance enablement and FinOps: own the cross-cutting concerns no single domain holds, infrastructure cost (FinOps), IAM posture, backup and disaster recovery, exit strategy, with automation and reporting that scales beyond the crew.

 5. AI-augmented infrastructure operations: make AI assistants a first-class citizen for incident investigation, runbook execution, and toil reduction, so engineers spend their time on high-leverage work.

👀 Focus for 2026:

In 2026, we're growing the team significantly to step up impact across four bets:

 - Multi-cloud expansion: revisit our cloud strategy as we go international, and launch new geographies.

 - Decoupling for scale: evolve service architecture to carry Alan 2.0 from 1M members today to 10M.

 - Operational excellence: raise the quality bar end-to-end by overhauling observability, on-call, and cost management practices.

 - AI-augmented infra ops: make AI assistants a first-class part of investigation, troubleshooting, and toil reduction, so engineers spend time where leverage is highest.




⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?




EXPERIENCE WE VALUE

 - 3+ years in Platform engineering, DevOps, Site reliability engineering or equivalent roles.

 - You have strong experience with cloud platforms (especially AWS or GCP).

 - You're comfortable writing code for automation and tooling (e.g. API, internal command line, developer portal) and willing to work in Python/Typescript (but you don’t need to have experience with those 2 languages!).

 - You have touched observability, monitoring, alerting or incident management tools and practices.

 - You are able to design and implement robust infrastructure systems with a focus on reliability and observability.

 - You can maintain our uptime targets while optimizing infrastructure costs.

 - You’ve built and maintained internal or external tooling (e.g. API, web interface, internal command line, configuration as code, etc) for other engineers.


MINDSET WE VALUE

 - You treat infrastructure and platform engineering as product work: engineers & members are your customers, and infrastructure should feel effortless.

 - You’re hands-on: writing code is the bulk of the job (Python, TypeScript, Terraform). You ship what you write to production yourself, then operate it: rollouts, alerting, on-call, incident response.

 - You're an enabler: you measure your impact by how fast product crews ship features without ever consulting you. The harder you've worked, the less they have to engage you.

 - You build reusable patterns: guardrails, libraries, and reliable-by-default abstractions that prevent outages and runaway cost at scale.

 - You’re fluent in English (French is not required).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire above C1 level range https://medium.com/alan/a-new-iteration-of-our-engineering-career-path-at-alan-f46f7b229b2d.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.




🌍 HOW WE WORK

 - Location: You must be legally eligible to work in France, Belgium, or Spain.

 - Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

The Alan Insurance Graduate Program is a unique opportunity to enter the team at the core of Alan Insurance business without getting silo-ed on a precise role. The Insurance team focuses on innovating on our health and disability insurance products, over 5 geographies including France, Belgium, Spain and Canada. Through the Program, you will develop a very precious blend of technical, business, entrepreneurial and product skills.

After a 2-months onboarding, you may be involved in multiple missions in different streams of the Insurance team:

 - The Enterprise and Public Sector stream structures the best offers for our largest clients, whether a ministry or a corporate. They land on our most important deals (RFP - request for proposal) with our Sales team, contributing to business growth in a very visible way. 

 - The insurance product stream dive into the lifecycle of a contract, from pricing and product implementation to the renewal phase. They team up with Engineer, Data and Marketing teams to ensure a delightful experience to our customers, whether when signing on our website, better equip Sales with the best offers or undergoing the renewal campaign (offer updates from one year to another).

 - The reinsurance and risk stream owns the Capital requirement model, the risk governance, the relationship with our Supervisor (ACPR) and the reinsurance coverage. 

Each program and mission will be co-built with you, to make the most of your growth plan and ensure you have impact and visibility from day 1 at Alan. 

All along your Graduate Program, you will also benefit from a personalized support from the team through coaching. This will ensure that you are never alone on a topic and that you grow fast, while still being in the driver’s seat. 

At Alan, we are at the forefront of the latest innovations in artificial intelligence. You will be expected to leverage every piece of technology at your disposal to contribute to scaling our tooling and processes.

jobs.description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


🐼 WHO WE ARE

You. Better. With Alan.

Alan's vision is to make prevention the new norm of care for all. Our mission is to help people live in good health to 100 while helping employers feel proud, turning health benefits from a cost centre into their most valuable investment.

We're building a vertically integrated health partner that seamlessly unites insurance and smart healthcare delivery into one system.

By connecting all aspects of care - private, public, and direct to consumer - we create the most member-centric healthcare experience. Through deep engagement, we empower everyone to overcome day-to-day health obstacles and live healthier lives.

We partner with 35K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M users , and have reached 770M+ in ARR.

Our team of 700+ people (still growing) operates across France 🇫🇷, Spain 🇪🇸, Belgium 🇧🇪, and Canada 🇨🇦.




🤘 HOW WE DO IT ?

People joining Alan are always surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values https://alan.com/about/company-culture that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us - We're obsessed with helping members live healthier

 - Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, mission above all else

 - Member & customer-led: obsessed with solving problems and delighting users

🏆 How we build excellence - We hire the best and empower them to succeed

 - Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density

 - Distributed ownership: everyone owns their decisions and results

 - Radically transparent: all information accessible, written-first, async decisions

🤝 How we grow together - We improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

 - Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care

 - Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback to help each other grow

 - Bold contrarians: think differently, try new approaches

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters

 - Disciplined execution: decisive action with compounding focus

 - Fight for simplicity: high-impact processes, smart frugality




🚀 WHY JOIN CARE OPS NOW AT THE BEGINNING OF 2026? 🚀

You might look at Alan’s Care team today—managing high volumes seamlessly, supported by strong partners, and automating 40% of conversations—and ask: "It works, so why join now?"

Yet, the most exciting part is still ahead. We are at a turning point as we prepare to support millions of members and push to set the standards in the industry.

Here is why this is the moment to join.

 - People: This is the opportunity to join a team with incredibly high talent density, operating with distributed ownership—empowered Crew Leads, strong deputies, and Guillaume Poirier https://www.linkedin.com/in/guillaume-p-34602923/ as Care Ops Lead. It is a proven engine for creating talent and fueling internal mobility.

 - Processes: We absorb high volumes without glitches (including Ministry of Finance in France) and collaborate smoothly with Product and Sales. We trust and work hand-in-hand with solid external partners in France and Spain.

 - Innovation: We are one of the few companies in the world claiming to automate 40% of member conversations as of end of 2025 (a true market benchmark).




We are pushing to create an organization capable of absorbing 3 million members with a lean team of Care Experts. To do this, we need to solve problems no one else has solved:

 - AI & Quality at Scale: We haven't yet fully engaged our partners to deliver high-quality, AI-powered service at scale.

 - Productivity: We are still resource-intensive. We know AI is the lever to crack the productivity of both our internal experts and external agents, and we are testing it—but we need to master it.

 - The Automation Glass Ceiling: We have hit 40%, but we need to break through to the next level.

Recognition: We are building something unique, yet we are not yet known externally as the reference for Care operations externally.




⭐ THE SENIOR CARE OPS ROLE ⭐

The Care Ops team supports the Care Community globally (France, Belgium, Spain, Canada) by providing tools, processes, and data to deliver on our Roadmap and Strategic Plan. Care Ops is accountable for operational excellence and efficiency in Care, enabling the Community to offer a delightful service at scale.

Care Ops collaborates closely with Care, Ops, Data, Engineers, and Product teams. Within a team of 8, we are seeking a Senior Care Ops to take the lead of one of our main verticals.

Some of the missions include:



1) Operational strategy & scalable systems

 - Own the strategy and execution plan for your vertical, aligned with Care’s strategic priorities (quality, member experience, scalability, cost-to-serve).

 - Diagnose performance gaps and root causes across the full Care journey, and translate them into a clear roadmap (initiatives, sequencing, expected impact, resourcing).

 - Define how we scale sustainably: operating model, tooling/process needs, automation opportunities, and measurement.



2) Performance management & continuous improvement

 - Be accountable for measurable outcomes for your vertical (e.g., member satisfaction, resolution quality, productivity, SLA/backlog health, cost-to-serve).

 - Build and maintain the right monitoring and rituals (dashboards, MBR, deep dives), ensuring we detect issues early and act fast.

 - Drive continuous improvement: test solutions, iterate quickly, and ensure changes stick through clear documentation, training, and adoption follow-up.



3) Cross-functional delivery (Product, Data, Engineering)

 - Write crisp problem statements and decision docs, align stakeholders, and drive execution from discovery to rollout.

 - Manage trade-offs between speed, quality, compliance, and cost, and bring the right stakeholders in early.



4) Stakeholder & change leadership

 - Lead the vertical as an “area”: create clarity on mission, roles, priorities, and rituals for contributors involved (Care Ops and Care Specialists).

 - Coach and support team members to grow their scope and impact through feedback, structured problem-solving, and ownership.

 - Influence senior stakeholders with clear narratives, data, and recommendations—internally and, when relevant, externally.



5) Outsourcing / partner management (possible scope)

 - Own partner strategy and governance: expectations, performance management, escalation paths, and continuous improvement plans.

 - Lead vendor selection and transitions when needed (RFPs, comparative analysis, negotiation, ramp-up plans).

 - Manage unit economics for outsourced scopes and drive cost-per-ticket improvements without compromising quality or member experience.




⭐ JOIN THE CARE OPS TEAM! ⭐️

You will excel as a Senior Care Ops if you:

 - Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and French, and can adapt your message from front-line teams to C‑level stakeholders (and, when relevant, external partners).

 - Have strong strategic thinking skills, and can translate Care’s roadmap and company priorities into a clear strategy for your vertical (quality, member experience, scalability, cost-to-serve), with an executable roadmap.

 - Demonstrate strong cross-functional leadership: you can align Care, Ops, Data, Engineers, and Product around a shared problem statement, make trade-offs, and drive delivery from diagnosis to rollout.

 - Are highly data-driven and outcome-oriented: you define the right metrics, build simple monitoring/rituals, identify root causes, and turn insights into durable improvements.

 - Have excellent program/project management skills, and can drive multiple complex initiatives in parallel (process changes, tooling improvements, automations, scope migrations) with clear owners, milestones, and impact tracking.

 - Are passionate about operational excellence: you iterate quickly, keep a high bar on user experience, and ensure changes stick through documentation, training, and adoption follow-up.

 - Can lead and grow an area/vertical: you set direction, create clarity, give feedback, and help Care Ops and Care Specialists increase their scope and impact over time.

 - Are comfortable making decisions in ambiguity, can work independently in a fast‑paced environment, and know when to bring others in early.

We’re looking for someone who has already owned and delivered a significant part of an operational (or Care) strategic plan, with clear ownership on outcomes (quality, cost-to-serve, scalability), ideally in a tech or high‑growth environment.

Experience with outsourcing / vendor management (e.g., BPOs, external partners) is a strong plus.

Experience across multiple countries or languages is a strong plus.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-E level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.




🙌   PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan/a/perks

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

 - Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

 - Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

 - Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

 - Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

 - Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.



IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

jobs.title: IT Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


MISSION

Alan is scaling internationally (900+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Operations Specialists to own device security, SaaS platforms, identity & access, and the daily IT experience of every Alaner, while contributing to build projects that remove operational toil.

IT at Alan is more than just a helpdesk. Operations and support ('Run') take roughly 60% of your time initially, while the rest goes toward owning project-based initiatives ('Build') tailored to your experience level. 
As you ramp up alongside senior engineers, your focus will naturally shift toward more build-focused work with wider impact.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. We staff people according to their strengths and interests, and it evolves over time.



SCOPE


🛟 SUPPORT & ONCALL

 - Own L1/L2 oncall for 900+ Alaners across 5+ countries, with a clear escalation path to engineers

 - Triage, communicate to users during incidents, and escalate appropriately

 - Document recurring issues and reduce ticket volume through self-service


💻 DEVICE LIFECYCLE & ENDPOINT COMPLIANCE

 - Own the full device lifecycle: procurement, zero-touch enrollment (Apple Business Manager, Kandji), repair, retrieval

 - Maintain role-based Kandji blueprints and least-privilege configurations

 - Contribute to device compliance across all countries (MDM, EDR, FileVault) and to audit evidence

 - Own the physical side: laptop locker, hardware inventory, office equipment

 - Take over day-to-day device operations as we bring them back in-house from our outsourced provider


🔑 IDENTITY, ACCESS & SAAS PLATFORMS

 - Own onboarding and offboarding end-to-end, across both automated and manually-managed tools

 - Administer Google Workspace, SSO/SAML, licences and access reviews

 - Manage day-to-day vendor relationships and procurement on your scope


⚙️ BUILD

 - Own a build project end-to-end, with a more experienced engineer to pair with and learn from

 - Examples from the current roadmap: rebuilding the onboarding intake, the meeting room audiovisual equipment and room-booking revamp, the IT playbook for new offices, ISO 27001 / ACPR evidence collection

 - Ship automation and self-service tooling that measurably reduces IT toil


MILESTONES

First 2 months

 - Join IT oncall rotation (helpdesk) with buddy/shadowing support

 - Discover Alan's processes, stack (Kandji, Apple Business Manager), SaaS ecosystem, and identity tools (Google Workspace, SSO, Alan Home)

 - Handle most typical IT operations issues autonomously (equipment, SaaS access, account provisioning)

First 6 months

 - Handle IT oncall shifts autonomously, solving most problems that do not require engineer input

 - Own onboarding/offboarding workflows end-to-end

 - Have wide knowledge of Alan's processes, equipment, and tools

 - Ship a first project

First year

 - Be regarded as an expert on at least one topic beyond the oncall rotation (e.g. MDM, SaaS admin, compliance documentation)

 - Contribute on device compliance improvements (MDM, EDR, FileVault) across all countries

 - Ship automation or self-service projects that measurably reduce IT toil, with limited guidance

 - Lead small to medium IT projects end-to-end

3 years

 - Fully autonomous on the User Experience & Platform workstreams

 - Lead medium to high-complexity IT projects end-to-end

 - Mentor newer team members, reduce bus factor through documentation, automation and knowledge sharing

jobs.title: People & Admin Ops.
jobs.description:
🩺 Why Prévenir

Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in the Île-de-France region.

Our ambition is to rethink occupational health in order to improve its impact on employees’ lives and the experience of healthcare professionals, leveraging Alan’s technology.

Our first medical centre has opened at 117 Quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris, and this is just the beginning!

👉 To learn more about what day-to-day life is like at Prévenir, click here https://prevenir.fr/carrieres.



⭐ The role, concretely

Are you excited about building, structuring and scaling HR operations in a company that's just getting started? You will join Prévenir at a very early stage and help build the foundations of our People and administrative operations as the company scales. This role is particularly suited to someone who has already experienced a fast-growth environment, whether in a start-up, scale-up or during a 0-to-100 journey.

We're in the early chapters: this isn't about running existing processes — it's about creating them from scratch so they hold up at much larger scale. The role brings a product mindset to People operations, where every key moment of the employee experience is carefully designed, with a constant focus on simplicity and automation. You'll work closely with Lucie, who makes the final calls depending on topic complexity and supports you as you grow into autonomy.

Your time is split between:

 - Employee journey: onboarding, probation-period tracking, setting up and running performance reviews, feedback processes, and monitoring team engagement.

 - Documentation & operational efficiency: writing clear, user-centric documentation, spotting friction, simplifying or automating recurring processes. You leverage AI to multiply the impact of your work.

 - People admin: leave and absence management, payroll back-and-forth, contracting and employee administrative follow-up, onboarding formalities and affiliations (health/provident insurance, occupational health), GDPR compliance.

 - Operational finance: expense reports, preparing and sending accounting documents to Impulsa, preparing routine filings (including VAT).

Over time, this person will take ownership of payroll management in coordination with our accounting partner, with training and support.



👤 The profile we're looking for

Essential:

 - At least 5-6 years of experience in People Ops, very hands-on, and comfortable with admin topics (e.g., managing the relationship with an accounting firm)

 - Previous experience in a fast-scaling company, start-up or scale-up, ideally having helped build or scale People processes during a period of significant growth.

 - Business curiosity: genuinely interested in what's happening on the business side, and able to connect your work to where the company is heading

 - Versatility across People and Corporate/Admin topics, with a strong People focus

 - Rigour and rock-solid attention to detail

 - Autonomy: you don't wait to be told there's a problem — you spot it, bring a solution, and know when to loop someone in on the tricky ones

 - Demonstrated interest in automating and improving recurring processes, and genuine enthusiasm for AI

 - Comfort interacting with a wide range of stakeholders, including senior profiles when needed

 - Fluent English (written and spoken) to interact with the Alan team

 - Based in Paris or the Île-de-France region, with the ability to work onsite regularly, ideally three days per week or more.

Ideally:

 - Experience in MedTech or in a start-up / scale-up

 - Sensitivity to the medical world (professional or personal)

 - Note: a 100% Occupational Health background may not be the right cultural fit, but worth testing



🙏 What we offer

 - Location: 117 Quai de Valmy, Paris 10th, in a brand-new centre designed to support high-quality practice

 - Base salary: between €53,000 and €61,000 gross per year, depending on experience and level

 - Profit-sharing scheme: 10%, in line with Prévenir’s framework

 - Benefits: daily transport costs covered, company restaurant, RTT days and regular team events

jobs.description:
CETTE OFFRE EST ÉGALEMENT DISPONIBLE EN ANGLAIS ICI https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/alan/20ef63db-a822-439f-86e5-12fb58880a3f. LES DEUX ANNONCES CONCERNENT LE MÊME POSTE.
__________________________________________________________________

LA SANTÉ N’ATTEND PAS.


Ni que les symptômes s’aggravent. Ni un rendez-vous dans six mois. Ni que le système rattrape son retard. Pourtant, c’est exactement comme cela que fonctionne le système de santé aujourd’hui. Vous attendez, jusqu’à ce que vous ne puissiez plus attendre.

Alan existe pour mettre fin à cette attente.

La santé est un droit universel, et nous pensons que ce droit ne peut devenir une réalité que s’il s’accompagne de prévention. Nous devons cesser de considérer la santé comme quelque chose que l’on répare, et commencer à la voir comme quelque chose que l’on construit, chaque jour. Ce n’est pas seulement une question de volonté. C’est le système de santé lui-même qui doit fonctionner pour tout le monde, de manière durable.

C’est pourquoi nous construisons le nouveau standard de l’assurance prévention. Alan est la première entreprise à intégrer assurance, prévention et soin au sein d’une seule et même expérience utilisateur saluée par tous.

Nous sommes engagés dans une aventure exceptionnelle pour bâtir une entreprise leader à l’échelle mondiale, portée par une culture unique https://alan.com/en/careers. Nous travaillons déjà avec plus de 40 000 entreprises de toutes tailles, accompagnons plus d’un million de membres et avons atteint plus de 800 millions d’euros de revenus annuels récurrents (ARR).

Faire de la prévention la nouvelle norme. C’est ce que nous construisons avec notre équipe de plus de 1 000 personnes. Si ce projet vous parle, nous recrutons en France, en Espagne, en Belgique, au Canada, et au-delà.

__________________________________________________________________



⭐ LE SERVICE CLIENT CHEZ ALAN


Tu rejoindras une équipe de plus de 100 spécialistes du service client, engagés et passionnés par leur métier. Au quotidien, nous travaillons main dans la main avec les équipes Opérations, Produit, Ventes, Assurance et bien d’autres.




🎯 TA MISSION


Ton rôle sera d’accompagner les membres d’Alan avec rapidité, clarté et bienveillance, pour leur permettre de comprendre leur couverture et d’avancer en toute confiance.

Concrètement, tu seras amené à :

 - Développer ton expertise des systèmes de santé et des produits Alan.

 - Aider les membres et les entreprises clientes à tirer le meilleur parti de leur couverture.

 - Partager tes observations et tes idées pour améliorer continuellement nos produits et nos services.

 - Participer à l’intégration de nouvelles entreprises clientes.

 - Collaborer avec différentes équipes sur des projets et initiatives stratégiques.

Au-delà de l’accompagnement des membres, tu contribueras à développer notre activité de service client au Canada et à améliorer l’expérience des membres.

Tu pourras notamment :

 - Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit, Opérations, Ventes et Assurance.

 - Adapter au contexte canadien les processus déjà mis en place par les équipes Support en France 🇫🇷, en Espagne 🇪🇸 et en Belgique 🇧🇪.

 - Travailler de manière autonome au sein d’une équipe à taille humaine.

 - Contribuer à améliorer l’intégration des entreprises, la proactivité du support Alan et l’expérience des membres.

 - Participer au recrutement et, si tu en as envie, accompagner et mentorer d’autres membres de l’équipe Support.
   
   


⭐ LE PROFIL QU'ON RECHERCHE


On recherche une personne avec au moins trois ans d’expérience pertinente, qui :

 - Aime profondément accompagner les membres et trouver des solutions à leurs problèmes.

 - Possède d’excellentes compétences en communication et en organisation.

 - Sait rendre simples et accessibles des sujets parfois complexes.

 - Parle et écrit couramment le français et l’anglais. Cette maîtrise est indispensable pour le poste.

 - Est à l’aise avec la technologie, le support multicanal et utilise l’IA avec enthousiasme pour structurer l’information, accélérer les tâches répétitives, améliorer la qualité de ses réponses et identifier des opportunités de rendre les processus plus efficaces.

 - Est à l’aise dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance, où il faut s’adapter rapidement, gérer plusieurs priorités de manière autonome et contribuer à l’amélioration continue.

 - A un esprit critique et constructif, ainsi qu’une vraie envie d’apprendre et de progresser.

 - A déjà une expérience en mentorat ou en leadership, ou souhaite développer ces compétences.

Une bonne connaissance du système de santé canadien est un plus. Si ce n’est pas encore ton cas, pas d’inquiétude, nous t’aiderons à monter en compétence.

Les candidatures de personnes ayant une expérience dans les domaines suivants sont également les bienvenues :

 - Opérations

 - Gestion de projets

 - Produit

 - Gestion de comptes
   
   


📍 LIEU DE TRAVAIL ET RÉMUNÉRATION


Le poste est basé dans notre bureau de Toronto, en Ontario, et requiert une présence sur site quatre jours par semaine.

⭐ THE PRODUCT MARKETING MANAGER B2C OPPORTUNITY

Building the engagement engine with Alan Play that makes 500k members come back to their health every single day, a key differentiator for Alan.

 

Today, 25k Alan members open Alan Play every day (120,000 every month) to walk, meditate, breathe, compete with their colleagues, build healthy habits. Play is Alan's #1 source of traffic and the retention engine of all our health services. And we are B2B2C: companies pay, members choose to engage. Play is a differentiator in deals, and at renewal. HR admins are also an underused distribution channel to reach members. Two audiences, one product story. By 2030 we want 500k daily users, across all our countries

 

The challenges: Our lifecycle is greenfield. Onboarding, activation, reminders, reactivation and win-back are owned by nobody today. We run events rebuilt almost from scratch, so the tenth Alan Cup costs as much as the first. We measure opens and clicks, not what a campaign actually did to daily engagement. And on the B2B side, our pitch goes stale between releases, as Play ships fast, so the sales argument does not keep up.

 

The future: A lifecycle layer designed for personalisation, running on the segmentation and experimentation platform Play has been building. Campaign machinery that gets cheaper every quarter. A measurement loop we trust, with holdouts and real incrementality. A live Play pitch that updates as features ship, so the field walks into a renewal or a deal with the current product. And HR admins turned into a real, measured distribution channel rather than a mailing list.

 

The hard parts: This role is horizontal, and vertical. Many member segments, many admin segments, several countries, coordination with Product as well as Sales, KAM and CSM, as well as other products teams who communicate with members.

 


⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?
jobs.requirements_raw:

 - Retention and lifecycle marketing at scale on a consumer product - subscription, gaming, social, media, health and fitness. Where engagement and retention are the business.

 - You build systems, not just campaigns - you can walk us through machinery you built that made the next campaign cheaper, and tell us what it cost you to get it adopted.

 - Analytical rigour - you read a funnel, design a segment, set up a holdout, call a result. You are comfortable being accountable to a product metric.

 - Horizontal operator - you have held many audiences and several countries at once. Volume and context switching, not depth on a single vertical.

 - Genuinely hands on - you want to run the campaigns yourself at the start. This is the ramp up, and the condition for standardising well afterwards.

 - Branding sensitivity : you can express the personality of the product you market and create great moments

 - You write well and fast. Emotion generating copy and branding  is a real part of the job

 - Marketing automation at scale - Customer.io http://Customer.io, Braze, Iterable or equivalent.

 - Missionary mindset and a real attachment to the health mission.

 - B2B2C sensibility:  you can maintain weigh in both segments

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - French, Spanish or Dutch on top of English, for four-country localisation

 - HR tech, employee benefits or workplace wellbeing

 - Gamification, challenges or social mechanics

 - Experience standardising something that other teams then reused

 


NOT A FIT IF

 - You describe success in open and click rates

 - You only want to talk to members, and see commercial side as somebody else's job

 - You need a brief, or someone who writes the strategy for you

PRODUCT BUILDER — SALES AI




⭐️ THE PRODUCT BUILDER ROLE ⭐️

Product Builders at Alan go deep on user needs, define a clear product strategy, and turn it into a high-impact roadmap.

 - You will work closely with designers, engineers and sales teams to define the right product and build it.

 - You will partner and align with every part of the business: sales, sales effectiveness, and our AI platform teams.



Sales AI: an exceptional opportunity to have an impact and grow

 - Our sales teams sell health insurance, a field that demands real expertise. Our internal tools have become powerful but fragmented, and AI is fundamentally reshaping how humans and tools interact. Alan’s growth ambitions are high: reaching them requires a step change in sales effectiveness — in time spent and in win rate.

 - So we are rethinking the entire sales experience from the ground up. Instead of tools Account Executives have to remember to open and prompt, we want an AI that works for the rep, including when they are not there: it processes information, analyzes a large pipeline of parallel deals, and comes back with “here is the priority today, do this and this.” A true assistant that helps reps prioritize, prepares work for them, and lets them build faster, more relevant offers, with the right sales material and arguments. With everything we know about past offers and the market, we can massively empower reps to walk in with a sharper offer and a sharper pitch.

 - The scope spans the full funnel: top funnel (automating prospection so reps get more, better-qualified discovery) and bottom funnel (winning offers, stronger pitches, higher win rate). Alan has strong maturity here: voice AI is live in France and Spain, outbound campaigns run autonomously, the CRM fills itself from call transcripts, and our offer copilot is used by more than half our reps — around 20% productivity gained this year. The limit today is structural: every capability lives in a separate tool, behind a manual trigger.

 - This is a validated, high-ambition bet to reinvent the sales experience, lift sales efficiency and win rate, and give every one of our clients a large-account-grade experience. And it does not stop at internal tooling: the same engine, pointed outward, can reach and answer customers directly in our self-serve funnel, and the approach can then be extended to other parts of Alan.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - Reinvent the sales workflow. Move our Account Executives and Key Account Managers from siloed AI tools they have to remember to use, to AI that proactively pushes the right action at the right moment in their workflow.

 - Build and sequence the roadmap. The scope is broad, so you will decide where to start, prioritize the highest-impact automation over “nice to have” AI features, and sequence the path to the full vision.

 - Get hands-on. We build many of our tools in an “everyone can build” mode. You will work close to the engine room, writing prompts, wiring connectors and evaluating outputs, to understand what is really happening and unblock progress.

 - Empower better, faster selling. Bring together what we know about offers, content and market signals so reps produce sharper offers faster — and automate the prospection work that fills their pipeline in the first place.

 - Keep the experience coherent. Partner closely with adjacent teams building AI agents in neighboring areas, so the overall experience stays consistent rather than siloed.

 - Drive the outcomes. Minimize time spent on low-value work while lifting offer relevance, win rate and the volume of qualified conversations each rep can run — so their time goes only to what needs a human.




⭐️ ABOUT YOU ⭐️

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have:

 - At least 5 years in a product role (or equivalent product ownership) in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment, ideally with AI or agentic products. Seniority matters here: the scope is exploratory and not fully defined yet.

 - Genuine excitement for AI. You have built AI products, or you are deeply eager to learn how LLM-based systems and agents behave in production, including their failure modes, and you can reason about the shift from pull-based to proactive, push-based experiences.

 - A builder mindset. You are hands-on and comfortable close to the product’s engine room (connectors, prompts, skills, evaluation) to understand what is really happening and unblock progress.

 - Appetite for the sales and insurance business. You are happy to sit with a rep, review an offer, and learn how guarantees and consumption terms are expressed, then turn that into product vision. You do not need to be a sales or insurance expert already, but you want to go deep fast.

 - Strong product execution. You set measurable goals, prioritize effectively, and ship iteratively, balancing quality, speed and impact.

 - The ability to bridge technical and non-technical worlds. You translate between platform and engineering constraints and sales reality, and drive alignment through clear framing and sharp decision-making.

 - Experience influencing without full authority. You can build the case for a new, ambitious bet and rally people around it.

 - Strong written communication in both internal and external-facing settings.

Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback combined with praises to help each other grow professionally

Bold & creative contrarians: think differently to achieve greatness, try new approaches


⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time

Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality




 💡 THE MISSIONS


Alan has grown to nearly 900 Alaners, with close to 300 hires completed in H1 2026 alone. 

The Workplace team is the engine behind the experience Alaners have every day — from their first day to the daily rhythm of office life. As the company scales, we need to scale with it: 

 - enhancing Alaners' experience wherever they work from, whether through the operational backbone of the office (vendors, procurement, RSE) 

 - or through the community moments that bring Alaners together — major events, simple rituals, and the art of designing genuine connection across teams and hubs.

We are opening one recruitment stream looking for two distinct profiles — both sitting in the Workplace community, both contributing to the same mission, but with distinct ownership areas.

When you apply, you're applying to a single stream. Throughout the process, we'll determine together which scope fits you best. 

Both roles share the same contract: Workplace Experience. 

While each profile comes with a clear focus area from the start, scopes are designed to evolve within the team, giving real room to grow over time.



The positions are based in Paris and require an onsite presence at least 4 days per week.

 

Detailed missions — shared across both profiles

 - Lead and support projects for the long-term improvement of our work environment as we grow

 - Contribute to Alan's growth through building and running scalable processes and documentation, leveraging data, AI and automation

 - Manage external providers and stakeholders: contractualization, invoicing, performance monitoring, tenders

 - Create and maintain secure, safe and comfortable work environments for all Alaners, in line with our Healthy Business positioning

 - Interact daily with cross-functional teams:
   
   - People — culture, onboarding and offboarding, perks, analytics, labor law
   
   - IT — facilities, network, room equipment, process automation, analytics
   
   - Security — office and work environment safety policies, crisis reaction
   
   - Finance — budget monitoring, taxes, invoicing, cost optimization
   
   - Legal — compliance, agreements

 - Contribute to the "on-call" rotation (daily run Office Management tasks)




👀 THE TWO PROFILES WE'RE LOOKING FOR




PROFILE A — OFFICE MANAGEMENT, PROCUREMENT & RSE (LEVEL RANGE TARGETED ON OUR LEVEL GRID: B0-B1)

Specific missions

 - Run day-to-day office operations at Valmy — our Paris HQ: office tours, maintenance follow-up, supply and equipment management

 - Manage and challenge the full vendor portfolio: onboarding, performance monitoring, contract tracking, invoicing, RFPs

 - Own office procurement: purchases, budget tracking, cost optimization, reporting

 - Lead Alan's RSE (Corporate Social Responsibility) approach: audit current practices, benchmark comparable organizations, build a prioritized action plan and drive concrete initiatives

Key outcomes by 1 year

 - Office operations at Valmy are running smoothly and reliably — daily rounds, maintenance follow-up and supply management are handled with no recurring gaps

 - Vendor portfolio is documented and tracked: contracts, invoices and performance are monitored consistently

 - Led at least two vendor reviews or benchmarking processes, produced clear findings and took corresponding decisions autonomously

 - Led an RSE audit: assessed what exists at Alan, benchmarked comparable organizations, proposed a realistic and prioritized action plan, and launched at least 2 concrete actions

 - Automated at least 3 manual or recurring tasks



You may be a great fit if you are:

 - An Office Manager with 2–4 years of experience, with a procurement or vendor management dimension, from a scale-up or fast-growing company

 - A Facilities coordinator who has managed multiple vendors simultaneously and owned budget lines

 - An operational profile with concrete RSE delivery experience




PROFILE B: EVENTS, ENGAGEMENT & INTERNAL COMMUNICATION

Target level on our level grid: B1-C1


ROLE MISSION

Own and develop Alan’s approach to events, engagement and internal communication. You will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to create meaningful connection rituals across our different locations and ways of working, while making thoughtful budget and prioritization decisions.

 - Define and evolve an annual events and engagement strategy aligned with Alan’s culture, work-from-anywhere policy and international development

 - Build and deliver a prioritized calendar of global events, local rituals and office-life initiatives, balancing impact, inclusiveness and cost

 - Bring creativity and resourcefulness to the design of memorable experiences that strengthen belonging across all Alaners, including those in our hubs in France, Belgium, Spain, Canada and beyond

 - Build and run a consistent internal communication layer around events and office life, working closely with the People team and Knowledge Manager on messaging, timing and formats

 - Manage event vendors and partners end-to-end, including agencies, caterers and venues, from sourcing and briefing to contracting, negotiation, invoicing and performance review

 - Own goodies and branded merchandise, including selection, logistics, stock management and cost tracking

 - Measure participation, feedback, costs and overall impact to continuously improve our approach


KEY OUTCOMES AFTER ONE YEAR

 - A clear events and engagement strategy, roadmap and set of priorities are defined and shared with key stakeholders

 - The annual event calendar is delivered on time and within budget

 - The events and engagement budget is fully owned, accurately tracked and actively managed through clear trade-offs

 - A balanced portfolio of global events, local rituals and low-cost formats is running across Paris and our hubs

jobs.description:
La santé n'attend pas.

Pas le temps que les symptômes s'aggravent. Pas six mois d'attente pour un rendez-vous. Pas le temps que le système rattrape son retard. C'est pourtant ainsi que fonctionne la santé aujourd'hui : on attend, jusqu'à ne plus pouvoir.

Alan existe pour mettre fin à l'attente.

La santé est un droit universel, et nous sommes convaincus que ce droit ne prend tout son sens que lorsqu'il va de pair avec la prévention. Il faut cesser de voir la santé comme quelque chose que l'on répare pour la penser comme quelque chose que l'on construit, jour après jour. Ce n'est pas qu'une question de volonté : c'est le système de santé lui-même qui doit fonctionner pour tous, et de façon durable.

C'est pourquoi nous bâtissons la nouvelle référence en matière d'assurance prévention. Alan est la première entreprise à réunir l'assurance, la prévention et les soins dans une seule expérience, saluée par nos membres.

Nous vivons une aventure hors du commun : construire une entreprise de premier plan à l'échelle mondiale, portée par une culture unique https://alan.com/en/careers. Nous comptons déjà plus de 40 000 entreprises clientes de toutes tailles, couvrons plus d'un million de membres et avons dépassé les $1B d'ARR.

La prévention comme nouvelle norme : voilà ce que nous construisons avec notre équipe de plus de 800 personnes. Si cela vous parle, sachez que nous recrutons en France, en Espagne, en Belgique et au Canada. Et au-delà.


🐼 Qui sommes-nous ?



Vous. En mieux. Avec Alan.



La vision d'Alan est de faire de la prévention la nouvelle norme des soins, pour tous. Notre mission : aider chacun à vivre en bonne santé jusqu'à 100 ans, et permettre aux employeurs de faire des avantages santé leur investissement le plus précieux, plutôt qu'un simple centre de coûts.

Nous bâtissons un partenaire santé intégré de bout en bout, qui réunit sans couture l'assurance et une offre de soins intelligente au sein d'un même système.

En reliant toutes les dimensions du soin — privé, public et en accès direct — nous créons une expérience de santé pensée autour du membre. Nous accompagnons chacun pour prendre soin de soi au quotidien et vivre en meilleure santé.



🤘 Comment travaillons-nous ?

Celles et ceux qui rejoignent Alan sont toujours surpris et séduits par notre méthode de travail. Un ensemble de valeurs culturelles https://alan.com/about/company-culture guide notre façon de faire, parmi lesquelles :



🎯 Ce qui nous anime — Aider nos membres à vivre en meilleure santé



1. La mission avant tout : penser à long terme et placer la réussite de notre mission au premier plan.

2. Satisfaire le membre et le client : nous sommes entièrement tournés vers la résolution de leurs problèmes et la création des expériences les plus agréables.



🏆 Comment nous cultivons l'excellence — Recruter les meilleurs et leur donner les moyens de réussir



1. Champions de l'excellence : des standards très élevés et une forte densité de talents.

2. Responsabilité distribuée : des « despotes éclairés » qui assument pleinement leurs décisions et leurs résultats.

3. Radicalement transparents : toute l'information est accessible et couchée par écrit en priorité, pour que chacun décide au mieux, de façon asynchrone.



🤝 Comment nous progressons ensemble — Nous aider mutuellement grâce aux feedbacks honnêtes et à une pensée audacieuse



1. Alchimie optimiste : des optimistes qui collaborent avec une bienveillance sincère et soutiennent leurs coéquipiers.

2. Challengers empathiques : des feedbacks directs et bienveillants, doublés d'encouragements, pour progresser ensemble sur le plan professionnel.

3. Contrariens audacieux et créatifs : penser autrement et oser de nouvelles approches pour viser l'excellence.



⚡ Comment nous avançons rapidement — Combattre la complexité et nous concentrer sur l'essentiel



1. Rigoureux dans l'exécution : agir avec détermination et une concentration qui fait fructifier le succès dans la durée.

2. Se battre pour la simplicité : uniquement des processus à fort impact, et une frugalité intelligente.



🙌 Qui recherchons-nous ? 🙌



Nous recherchons un psychothérapeute pour notre nouveau service de téléthérapie destiné à nos membres au Québec. Si vous avez envie d'être à l'avant-garde de l'innovation et de rejoindre une équipe exceptionnelle, ce poste est fait pour vous. Fidèles à nos valeurs de simplicité, de transparence et de prévention, nous sommes pleinement mobilisés pour offrir une expérience remarquable aux Québécoises et aux Québécois, avec le lancement de notre service au Québec et partout au Canada 🇨🇦 (les permis valables dans plusieurs provinces sont donc les bienvenus !).



🌳 Critères de sélection :



* Maîtrise du français à l'oral et à l'écrit (langue maternelle ou niveau équivalent), les séances avec nos membres au Québec se déroulant majoritairement en français.

* Détenir le droit d'exercer la psychothérapie au Québec, c'est-à-dire l'un des statuts suivants :

    Psychologue membre en règle de l'Ordre des psychologues du Québec (OPQ) ; ou

    Titulaire du permis de psychothérapeute délivré par l'OPQ, à titre de membre en règle d'un ordre professionnel habilité — notamment l'Ordre des travailleurs sociaux et des thérapeutes conjugaux et familiaux du Québec (OTSTCFQ) ou l'Ordre des conseillers et conseillères d'orientation du Québec (OCCOQ) ; ou

   * Médecin membre du Collège des médecins du Québec autorisé à exercer la psychothérapie.

 Connaissance du français reconnue aux fins de l'admission à l'ordre professionnel : les personnes n'ayant pas fait leurs études en français doivent avoir réussi l'examen de français de l'Office québécois de la langue française (OQLF), conformément à la Charte de la langue française.

* Bonne connaissance de la TCC (thérapie cognitivo-comportementale), de la thérapie des schémas, de l'EMDR ou de la thérapie ACT.

* Des spécialités en phase avec les besoins de nos membres : stress, épuisement professionnel, estime de soi, dépression et traumatismes.

* Une spécialisation en thérapie auprès des adultes.

* De 5 à 7 ans d'expérience professionnelle au minimum.

* Une disponibilité d'au moins 3 heures par semaine.

* Une réelle aisance avec les outils et plateformes numériques.

* Une preuve d'assurance responsabilité professionnelle (minimum de 5 M$ CA).



⭐ Des atouts supplémentaires :



* La maîtrise d'une autre langue (anglais, espagnol, arabe, créole, etc.).

* Un permis d'exercice dans une autre province (p. ex. Ontario, Colombie-Britannique ou Alberta).

* Une formation en thérapie cognitive basée sur la pleine conscience (MBCT).



⚡️ Processus de recrutement :



Le processus se déroule en deux étapes. Vous pourrez bien sûr poser toutes vos questions : nous recherchons des personnes exceptionnelles et tenons à ce que vous mesuriez pleinement l'aventure qui vous attend.



* Premier entretien :

   * Rencontre avec l'équipe Alan (30-45 minutes), pour faire connaissance et préciser notre organisation et nos attentes.

* Deuxième entretien :

   * Entretien technique (45 minutes) avec Lydia Martin, responsable du programme mondial de santé mentale d'Alan. Titulaire d'un doctorat en psychologie, elle échangera avec vous sur votre expertise et vos connaissances thérapeutiques.



Feedback : dans l'esprit de transparence propre à Alan, nous nous efforçons de donner du feedback à chaque étape et de revenir vers vous sous 48 heures (les fins de semaine ne comptent pas !).



🙌 Avantages et privilèges



Chez Alan, vous contribuez à bâtir la plateforme de santé mentale de nouvelle génération, qui donne à de nombreuses personnes accès à un accompagnement personnalisé. Voici ce que nous offrons :



* Une rémunération attrayante.

* Une grande souplesse d'horaire et de lieu de travail : vous pouvez travailler depuis votre domicile ou votre cabinet (les rendez-vous avec nos membres se déroulent en téléconsultation).

* La possibilité de rejoindre une communauté soudée de thérapeutes, où grandir, échanger et apprendre ensemble.

* La participation à une réunion d'équipe d'une heure chaque mois.



Note importante : nous recrutons des personnes, pas des rôles.



Après avoir lu cette description, si vous avez le sentiment de ne pas réunir tous les prérequis, mais que le poste correspond à là où vous en êtes ou à ce vers quoi vous souhaitez évoluer, nous vous encourageons à postuler.



Tout le monde n'ira pas au bout de notre processus de recrutement, mais chacun, aussi sous-représenté soit-il, devrait se sentir libre de tenter sa chance : il n'y a que des apprentissages, ou des réussites, à en tirer.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⚡ THE CORPORATE TEAM AT ALAN

You will join Alan's Corporate team, the unit that covers legal, privacy, governance, risk, compliance and security as Alan scales.

Alan wants to be in 10 countries within five years, and that only works with corporate processes built to scale with it. This is a newly created role, and your job is to make Alan's regulated development seamless and integrated with how we build product.

You will benefit from close mentorship and structured support, you won't be left on your own, and the deep legal, privacy, and security expertise stays in the team around you. At Alan, roles evolve, so you will have real opportunities to expand your scope across topics and countries as you grow.




🤝 YOUR MISSIONS

Corporate protects Alan and its members, but regulated work can still be slow, manual and disconnected from how we build. You are here to build the compliance product that fixes that: processes and tooling that hold as Alan grows, and that make regulated work lighter on both sides, for the teams you serve and for the experts you work with.

 - Make regulated work scale. Alan's regulatory load grows with every new member, market and product. You build the layer that absorbs it, so Corporate's load stops climbing in lockstep with the company: a clear path from each request to the right owner, and tooling that takes on the recurring work.

 - Rebuild processes end to end. You find the painful process, work out what people are really doing to get around it, and redesign it so it is faster for everyone. You stay on it after launch, watch how it is used, and keep improving it until it becomes the way people work.

 - Spot the next bottleneck before it bites. You design solutions that keep Alan compliant and fast at the same time, rather than trading one for the other.

 - Measure what you ship. You set clear goals and check them, so every change makes life easier on both sides: the Corporate team you work with and the people they serve.
   
   

In your first six months, you will have:

 - Shipped a first system that gives the teams you serve one simple, fast way to get what they need from Corporate.

 - Owned at least one process from problem to a live, automated solution that people actually use.

 - Become a trusted, pragmatic builder for the Corporate team and for the people they serve.




🚀 PROFILE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

What you bring

 - You have built things people kept using. You have turned manual, repetitive work into automated or self-serve solutions with no-code, low-code and AI tools, whether at work, in internships, or on your own projects.

 - You are drawn to regulated work. You want to understand why these processes exist and where they create friction, and you ramp up fast on a domain that is new to you. Hands-on experience in one of these areas is a plus that speeds your ramp-up, not a requirement.

 - French and English (professional level).



Qualities we look for to join our team

 - Builder mindset: You move fast and autonomously, prioritise ruthlessly, test as you go, favour delivery over polish, and collaborate to ship.

 - Explorer mindset: You are curious about a vague problem, dig deep to frame it well, stay solution-oriented, and escalate early.

 - Appetite for regulated complexity: The complexity of regulated work energises you as much as the tooling does, and you approach it with a try-and-retry, challenger mindset.

 - Sound judgment: You sense where a shortcut would break a legal, privacy, security or compliance requirement, and you know when to stop and ask.

 - Project ownership: You drive projects end to end, from user research and planning to delivery, and you own what happens after launch: adoption and continuous improvement.

 - Clear communication: You are proactive and clear with stakeholders, you show progress, and you explain why.



For this role we are looking to hire within the B1-C0 level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France, Belgium or Spain.

⭐ YOUR MISSION

Brokers play a structural role in how large and very large employers select, negotiate, and manage their health and prévoyance coverage. We're looking for a Broker Partnerships Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with the brokers who operate in the Enterprise segment, turning Alan into a trusted, credible, and commercially compelling partner for those actors, and supporting our Enterprise Sales and Key Account Management teams.




⭐ LOCATION

On-site in Paris, Île-de-France.

What makes this role genuinely unique

 - You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health insurance companies builds its relationships with the brokers operating in the large and very large employer segment across France, and beyond.

 - You'll have real ownership from day one and operate at the highest levels of the broker market.

 - You'll shape Alan’s broker strategy and execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability. The playbook is yours to define and scale.

 - You'll work directly with Alan's Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, Insurance, and Executive Leadership.




⭐ YOUR ROLE

Relationships & Presence

 - Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the brokers that sit between us and the largest employers in our markets (whether private or public), at senior and managing director level.

 - Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design Alan's engagement strategy.

 - Be the consistent Alan voice that brokers recognize: someone who shows up, follows through, and is known as easy to deal with without giving away what shouldn't be given.



Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Commercial work

 - Be a partner to our Enterprise Sales and KAM teams on every broker situation: drive strategic decisions deal by deal and turn ecosystem knowledge into commercial leverage.

 - Introduce the right broker contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle,  transforming relationship capital into pipeline access on large and very large accounts.

 - Share Alan's value and positioning with broker partners to help them understand, represent, and actively promote Alan within their client portfolios.

 - Hold the line on our non-negotiables while finding creative ways to make the collaboration work for both sides.



Sector Engagement & Anticipation

 - Follow the broker market at deal level and ecosystem level: who is growing, who is consolidating, where portfolio shifts are happening, and what it means for Alan's pipeline and positioning.

 - Be a sharp, early internal voice on where the broker market is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy, including on consolidation, regulation, and competitive dynamics.



Build & Scale

 - Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on broker positions, portfolio footprints, engagement history, and contractual frameworks shared with Enterprise Sales and KAM teams to increase win rates.

 - Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our broker engagement and contract documentation (conventions de courtage, commission tracking, data sharing agreements).

 - Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Commercial team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

 - Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how brokers position Alan vs. incumbents, how they advise clients on insurer selection, and where we are perceived as "difficult to work with" — and feed that back into product, pricing, and GTM strategy.




⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

You’ll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

 - Have at least 8 years of total experience working with or inside the broker ecosystem: at a broker or in an external partnership or distribution role at a health insurer or mutuelle

 - Have legitimate credibility at senior broker level: ability to engage managing director and senior leadership at major brokers as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive deal-level engagement on the insurer or employer side

 - Have deep knowledge of the broker ecosystem in the large and very large employer segment: how brokers operate, how they are compensated, how they advise clients, and how they influence insurer selection at this scale

 - Have deep understanding of health and prévoyance insurance: the technical dimension (garanties, gestion, régimes, prévoyance) must be native, not learned on the job

 - Have proven ability to build trust with broker counterparts from the insurer or employer side: long-game, trustworthy, discreet, commercially disciplined

 - Demonstrate outstanding stakeholder management: calm, ego-free, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself and equally able to hold firm positions internally when sales pressure pushes toward broker accommodation beyond our framework

 - Demonstrate commercial impact from prior broker-related work: broker relationships that translated into material deal flow, pipeline access, or portfolio migration

 - Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with limited process and real autonomy

 - Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-H level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As our Community & Advocacy Manager, you'll be the human presence behind Alan in the places our audience spends time online: Reddit, review sites like Trustpilot, forums, comment sections on Meta or LinkedIn, DMs. This is a hands-on, highly executional role. You'll participate authentically in these communities, build and grow Alan's own community spaces (starting with our own subreddit), and turn happy members and credible creators into a network of advocates who vouch for Alan in their own words.

You'll report to Alan’s SEO/GEO Lead. You’ll work in close, day-to-day partnership with our senior Organic Social Media Lead, who owns Alan's broader organic social strategy and focuses mostly on Meta & LinkedIn. You'll start with the French market and help extend the playbook to Belgium, Spain and Canada as Alan grows.




WHAT THE CONVERSATIONS ARE ABOUT

People post about their situation: a freelancer who just registered and needs cover, parents weighing a child's orthodontics, someone asking how much a mutuelle will pay back on a 1,500€ dental bill, the founder of a six-person startup setting up a first collective plan, a retiree comparing senior options, someone tired of weak reimbursements and ready to switch.

You meet people in those threads, and in the reviews and forums where the same questions come up. Alan’s audience is composed of:

 1. Companies. HR leaders, founders and other decision-makers across industries who bring Alan to their teams. These conversations live more on LinkedIn and in professional/HR communities.

 2. Individuals. Freelancers and the self-employed (TNS), public-sector workers, retirees, and students.

Around this sits a widening set of health topics where Alan wants to be useful and trusted: mental health, women's health, parenthood and fertility, preventive care, chronic conditions, the everyday experience of the app and getting reimbursed, and the questions HR and employer decision-makers ask.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Be present in the conversation.

 - Own Alan's day-to-day engagement across Reddit, review sites (Trustpilot and similar), forums, comment sections for example on Meta or LinkedIn, and DMs. Answer real questions about health insurance and mutuelles with responses that are timely, genuinely helpful, accurate and on-brand.

 - Stay close to internet culture. Constantly monitor the algorithms, related trends and meme formats, health-Reddit/X narratives, and rising creators to keep our community presence cutting-edge and relevant.

Build and grow Alan's own community spaces.

 - Create and actively run the official Alan subreddit. Set its norms, seed good discussion, moderate fairly, and grow it into a place people trust.

 - Identify additional communities to contribute, and build a genuine presence there over time.

Turn members and creators into advocates.

 - Spot Alan's existing champions: happy members, engaged health professionals, HR admins already recommending us. Build relationships with them and create pathways from engaged user to ambassador to advocate.

 - Identify high-value Reddit and community creators, recruit and nurture them, set the bar for what great contribution looks like, and create the structures that turn engaged users into genuine advocates.

 - Run community-first moments (AMAs, Q&As, recognition for top contributors) that give advocates a reason to show up.

Listen, and bring the voice of the community back to the business.

 - Monitor sentiment, recurring questions and pain points.

 - Translate what you hear into clear, qualitative insight for Product & SEO/GEO teams: product painpoints, feature ideas, prompt monitoring ideas, etc.

 - Feed the senior Organic Social Media Lead & Ad Creative Lab a steady stream of raw material (real member stories, recurring questions, use cases) for Alan's content engine.

Leverage AI tools to scale your operations.

 - We expect you to use AI tools to move fast without sacrificing accuracy or depth. We are heavy AI users and expect every team member to be as passionate and forward-thinking about AI as we are.
   
   


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills in English & French.

 - 1-3 years in community management, social media, or customer engagement; or a strong personal track record of community participation. We care about real credibility, not follower counts.

 - You're genuinely active in online communities yourself, especially Reddit. You understand how subreddits work: their culture, their moderation, what earns trust and what gets removed.

 - Exceptional written communication skills. You write clearly and precisely, and adapt your tone naturally across contexts.

 - Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate community metrics (sentiment, engagement rate, conversions, contribution quality) into actionable strategy.

 - Excited about being hands-on and executional. This is a role for someone who wants to do the work themselves, not direct others. You will have state-of-the-art AI tooling to help you automate much of your work.

 - Organized, proactive, and comfortable building structure in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

 - An eye for people: you spot power users and creators worth a relationship, and you're comfortable doing outreach.

 - Curiosity about health, insurance, or the day-to-day realities of Alan's audience (freelancers, HR people, and so on).


NICE TO HAVE

 - An existing, credible presence in relevant online communities (an established Reddit account, forum reputation, etc.).

 - Experience moderating a subreddit or online forum.

 - Experience running influencer or creator partnerships on any platform.

 - Comfortable on camera and recording lightweight video.

 - Experience working at a fast-paced startup or scale-up.
   
   


WHY JOIN

1. You shape real decisions, at the moment they're made.

Choosing a health insurer is a decision people find stressful, and they don't trust ads. So they ask real people. They post in Reddit threads, comb through reviews, and dig into forums looking for someone honest. Whoever shows up in those moments shapes the decision. Today, Alan is barely there. This role exists to change that. You become the reason a person lost in mutuelle jargon finds a clear, straight answer, and the reason they discover a true health partner built to serve them.

2. You build a system, not a treadmill.

This is not a role where you do the same thing week after week for five years. You design how Alan shows up across communities at scale: an advocacy engine that turns happy members and credible creators into a network of voices, supported by AI tooling and automation that takes care of the repetitive work. The craft is in building that machine and making it sharper over time, not in grinding through a checklist.

3. You're early to where trust and discovery are heading.

Search and advertising are giving way to communities, peer recommendation, and AI answer engines as the way people decide who to trust. This role sits right on that shift. The playbook you build and the instincts you sharpen here are becoming some of the most valuable skills in marketing, and for Alan this is fast becoming one of the main ways future members ever discover us.
