 - Run our Insurance or Health services processes - that's why we call them Ops Runners internally 😉

 - Ensure the day-to-day follow up and monitoring of our operations

 - Flag risks and opportunities

In details, your missions are:

 - Operating our processes: performing tasks like invoicing or claims treatment, growing and managing our network of providers, supporting internal teams (live and through documentation)

 - Contributing to the definition & owning the best monitoring scheme to track volumes/efficiency/SLAs, and identify risks and areas of improvement, internally or with our service providers

 - Supervising partnerships (e.g. teleconsultation, claim operators), participating in the negotiation rounds, daily communication to ensure business continuity

 - Performing controls on our daily operations to make sure the correct decisions were made and to identify training needs (internally as well as externally)

 - Escalating feedback, helping to prioritise and supporting initiatives to make our processes and services more delightful and efficient

Next to running and monitoring our operations, you implement continuous improvements to our processes (+-20/30% of the time). This can be in a variety of ways, e.g. working with product teams to automate certain processes, enhancing our external communication, auditing our processes, automating some process steps using automation tools, …




⭐️ OUR RUN ORGANISATION ⭐️

Our Operations Coordinators or Ops Runners are organized in pools (3-7 runners) who are collectively responsible for running their scope. Examples of topics are:

Alan therapy: members can book a therapy session with psychologists. You maintain smooth relationships with our psychologists, ensure therapy demand  matches the supply and contribute to several steps of their lifecycle at Alan (hiring, onboarding, invoicing, supporting booking management etc).

Claims: We provide a best-in-class claims experience, including our own optic care service. You treat claims and assist in decisions regarding our coverage. Additionally, you monitor the performance of external service providers to meet SLAs & perform quality controls. You ensure glasses get delivered on time, member satisfaction is high, our frame collection is attractive, collaboration with opticians is smooth and efficient, ….

Fraud: We run checks on claims submitted by our members, and build new ways of preventing fraud attempts. You investigate suspicious claims, prevent fraudulent payments or recover when we paid fraudulent claims.

Set up:  We provide best-in-class experience to our Customers : a smooth on/offboarding of their employees and a seamless invoicing or billing. To do so, we continuously control & improve the quality of our processes : ensuring we have consistent information for invoicing, unlocking employee invite/removals in case of issue and supporting admin in case of payment issue or bankruptcy.

Note: We look for profiles able to embrace any challenge and jump in any pool ! Depending on Alan needs (and personal interests), an Operations Coordinator will join in a pool and  can change and explore new scopes after some time. Do not hesitate to ask more concrete examples to the Operations Team Members you’ll meet during the process so they can share about their own scope.




⭐️ EXPERIENCE ⭐️

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

Since the scope of our Ops Runner role is extremely varied, we are open to candidates from different backgrounds : you could be a good fit for the Operations team at Alan if, for example, you:

 - Operated processes and services especially for companies during the scale up stage or in industrial/logistic industries

 - Worked in Support functions (Customer Support, People Operations etc)

 - Had a Customer facing Commercial experience, e.g. account manager or Customer Success Communications, such as Social Media, Internal/ External Communications

 - Handled event coordination




⭐️ SKILLS ⭐️

 - Passionate about delivering & optimizing top notch operations: not scared to get your hands dirty to get into technical processes, making them clear and delightful for our operators and members

 - A keen problem-solver and challenger with a dig deep mindset: what drives you is member and customer satisfaction !

 - Analytics skills, to be able to dive into our data

 - Highly organised with exceptional follow-up skills, with strong attention to details

 - Strong and structured in written and verbal communication in English and Dutch 

 - Able to work and learn independently in a fast-paced environment

 - Adaptable: you show flexibility and a strong ability to adapt to variable situations

 - It’s even better if you have experience in the insurance or the healthcare industry




🙌  PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan/a/perks

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

 - Establish medical governance and ensure quality & safety - set up clinical committees, case reviews, and incident management. Develop protocols aligned with national guidelines and Alan member first mindset, define appropriate teleconsultation use cases, ensure compliance.

Monitor and improve clinical practice

 - Define clinical practices for integrated care - create telemedicine guidelines that optimize medical quality, patient experience, and cost-effectiveness across the care pathway.

 - Drive outcomes that matter - establish metrics beyond process indicators: health impact, member experience, cost-effectiveness, and specific clinical patterns and contribute to their monitoring and analysis.

Contribute to shaping tomorrow's care

 - Shape AI-augmented practice - collaborate with product teams to integrate AI effectively into clinical workflows

 - Medical degree (GP or relevant specialty), registered with French Medical Council, 5+ years post-qualification experience. Public health or digital health training is a plus.

 - Team leadership experience - you've managed medical teams and/or coordinated complex cross-functional projects.

 - Corporate healthcare experience (health tech, insurers, digital health) or public health sector outside hospitals. You grasp business and organizational dynamics, and collaborate naturally with non-medical teams.

 - Digital health & telemedicine experience (Qare, Livi, Doctolib, etc.) with genuine excitement about AI as an enabler of better care

 - Value-based healthcare experience - you've designed care pathways that balance clinical quality, patient experience, GP engagement, and cost-effectiveness in real-world settings.  - build our AI-powered production system for scalable content production, and grow engaged communities across platforms

DETAILED MISSIONS

1. Build the organic social media strategy

Global role:

 - Define Alan's social voice, creative direction, and platform-specific frameworks (LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube), including which personas to target on each channel

 - Drive coordination with Brand, Product Marketing, and Growth to ensure social is embedded in every major moment (product launches, campaigns, events)

 - Bridge organic and paid efforts on Meta and YouTube, ensuring both work in concert to maximize reach, consistency, and performance

 - Align with each country team on editorial pillars (key themes and topics reflecting Alan's positioning) and platform priorities (which channels to activate and at what intensity per market)

 - Set the measurement framework: follower composition, UTM tracking, brand awareness surveys, and social listening, with regular performance reviews shared cross-functionally

France execution:

 - Own and execute the France organic social strategy end-to-end, across the full content mix: educational content, product storytelling, employer brand, community engagement, and campaign amplification

 - Ensure France content is consistent with global frameworks while reflecting local market nuances

2. Build and operate an AI-powered content production and distribution engine

 - Design and implement an agentic content workflow using AI tools (LLMs, image generation, video automation) to dramatically increase production velocity without proportional headcount growth

 - Create a scalable system where subject-matter experts across the company (product, medical, growth, country teams) feed raw inputs (data, stories, product updates) that get transformed into publish-ready content at scale

 - Define and operate the distribution logic: publishing cadence, platform-specific formatting, timing, and scheduling across all active channels


3. Build a solid performance and measurement framework

 - Set up and own the measurement framework: follower composition, UTM tracking, brand awareness, social listening

 - Share regular performance reviews cross-functionally

 - Define KPIs connecting social activity to business outcomes (traffic, brand awareness, audience quality)

 - Use data to make autonomous editorial decisions and iterate on content strategy


KEY OUTCOMES BY 1 YEAR

 1. A clear, living organic social media strategy is in place and understood across Alan — platforms are prioritized, editorial pillars are defined, and Brand, Product Marketing, Growth, and country teams are aligned on what Alan stands for on social and how to contribute to it

 2. An AI-powered content production system is operational : agentic workflows handle scheduling, drafting, and basic repurposing, freeing up human time for creative strategy and high-value content

 3. Platform activation and posting cadence have been defined and implemented based on audience data and strategic priorities

 4. A measurement framework is live : we know who follows us, whether content drives traffic, and whether brand awareness among target audiences is moving

 5. Social has demonstrably amplified at least 2 major brand campaigns: the person has owned the organic social amplification strategy end-to-end for at least two significant brand moments, with measurable contribution to reach and engagement vs. previous benchmarks

Social strategy & editorial thinking

Content production

 - Can produce social-first content autonomously across formats (short video, carousel, static, copy-led posts), both hands-on and through AI-assisted workflows

 - Experienced with AI tools for content creation and able to design agentic pipelines

 - Has an eye for what works natively on each platform, not someone who repurposes the same content everywhere

Data & analytics

 - Able to read social analytics and turn them into actionable editorial decisions

 - Experienced building simple and rigorous reporting frameworks

 


SOFT SKILLS / BEHAVIOURAL TRAITS

 - Ownership mindset : takes full responsibility for the social presence

 - Systems thinker : thinks in workflows and leverage points, not just individual posts

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

 2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

 3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

 4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.


⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

 - 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

 - Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

 - Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

 - Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

 - A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

 - The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

 - An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

 - Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

 - Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⚡ THE CORPORATE TEAM AT ALAN

You will join Alan's Corporate team, the unit that covers legal, privacy, governance, risk, compliance and security as Alan scales.

Alan wants to be in 10 countries within five years, and that only works with corporate processes built to scale with it. This is a newly created role, and your job is to make Alan's regulated development seamless and integrated with how we build product.

You will benefit from close mentorship and structured support, you won't be left on your own, and the deep legal, privacy, and security expertise stays in the team around you. At Alan, roles evolve, so you will have real opportunities to expand your scope across topics and countries as you grow.




🤝 YOUR MISSIONS

Corporate protects Alan and its members, but regulated work can still be slow, manual and disconnected from how we build. You are here to build the compliance product that fixes that: processes and tooling that hold as Alan grows, and that make regulated work lighter on both sides, for the teams you serve and for the experts you work with.

 - Make regulated work scale. Alan's regulatory load grows with every new member, market and product. You build the layer that absorbs it, so Corporate's load stops climbing in lockstep with the company: a clear path from each request to the right owner, and tooling that takes on the recurring work.

 - Rebuild processes end to end. You find the painful process, work out what people are really doing to get around it, and redesign it so it is faster for everyone. You stay on it after launch, watch how it is used, and keep improving it until it becomes the way people work.

 - Spot the next bottleneck before it bites. You design solutions that keep Alan compliant and fast at the same time, rather than trading one for the other.

 - Measure what you ship. You set clear goals and check them, so every change makes life easier on both sides: the Corporate team you work with and the people they serve.

In your first six months, you will have:

 - Shipped a first system that gives the teams you serve one simple, fast way to get what they need from Corporate.

 - Owned at least one process from problem to a live, automated solution that people actually use.

 - Become a trusted, pragmatic builder for the Corporate team and for the people they serve.




🚀 PROFILE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

What you bring

 - You have built things people kept using. You have turned manual, repetitive work into automated or self-serve solutions with no-code, low-code and AI tools, whether at work, in internships, or on your own projects.

 - You are drawn to regulated work. You want to understand why these processes exist and where they create friction, and you ramp up fast on a domain that is new to you. Hands-on experience in one of these areas is a plus that speeds your ramp-up, not a requirement.

 - French and English (professional level).



Qualities we look for to join our team

 - Builder mindset: You move fast and autonomously, prioritise ruthlessly, test as you go, favour delivery over polish, and collaborate to ship.

 - Explorer mindset: You are curious about a vague problem, dig deep to frame it well, stay solution-oriented, and escalate early.

 - Appetite for regulated complexity: The complexity of regulated work energises you as much as the tooling does, and you approach it with a try-and-retry, challenger mindset.

 - Sound judgment: You sense where a shortcut would break a legal, privacy, security or compliance requirement, and you know when to stop and ask.

 - Project ownership: You drive projects end to end, from user research and planning to delivery, and you own what happens after launch: adoption and continuous improvement.

 - Clear communication: You are proactive and clear with stakeholders, you show progress, and you explain why.



For this role we are looking to hire within the B1-C0 level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.




🌍 HOW WE WORK



Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France, Belgium or Spain.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

⚙️ PLATFORM & AUTOMATION

 - Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices


🔑 IDENTITY & ACCESS

 - Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

 - Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

 - Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

 - Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

 - Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack


🔒 ENDPOINT & SAAS SECURITY

 - Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

 - Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

 - Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope


🩺 HEALTH PROFESSIONALS IT

 - The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

 - Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process


🌍 INTERNATIONALISATION

 - Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

 - Bring acquired entities onto that same platform


MILESTONES

First 3 months

 - Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

 - Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

 - Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

 - Own a workstream end-to-end, with an IT Ops teammate working alongside you

 - Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

 - Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

 - Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

 - Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

 - Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

 - Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

 - Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

 - Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

 - Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

 - Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

Pricing

 - Contribute to the portfolio renewal strategies, in close collaboration with internal teams (Strategy, Product, Sales, etc.) and external stakeholders (insurer, reinsurers).
   
   

Underwriting & product launch

 - Support underwriting teams throughout the year with technical analysis, guidelines, ad hoc methodologies, as well as automation initiatives.

 - Provide technical input to the launch of new products or geographies.

 - Contribute to the reinsurance plans definition and optimisation year on year, including partnership management.



Team Growth

 - Create processes and resources to strengthen the team’s ability to price and steer the Prevoyance portfolio.

 - Support the identification and hiring of new talents for the Insurance team.

 - Build internal knowledge of Prévoyance both for newcomers onboarding and stakeholders upskilling.

 - Have experience in insurance, portfolio monitoring and pricing

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is Python/Flask, React, React Native, PostgreSQL.

Want to know more? Read this article https://blog.alan.com/tech-et-produit/engineering-organisation-at-alan if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article https://medium.com/alan/engineering-career-path-at-alan-e5de5c2e740c on our Engineering career path.




🌐 ENABLING GLOBAL-FIRST PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

In Alan's early expansion https://medium.com/alan/an-unexpected-journey-the-tale-of-the-backend-architecture-at-alan-ac8c5382df60, we made a strategic decision to create separate codebases for each country we ventured into. This approach allowed us to quickly adapt and tailor our applications to meet the unique healthcare and regulatory requirements of France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada.

In 2024 https://medium.com/alan/engineering-challenges-at-alan-in-2024-686688f6b89d, we reached a crucial point where it was essential to merge these codebases into global, configurable modules. Yet, writing local code is still easier than building global solutions. The Global Architecture team is central to this transformation — our goal is to enable any team at Alan to develop and launch features seamlessly across markets, as outlined in our 2025 technical strategy https://medium.com/alan/alans-2025-technical-strategy-building-tomorrow-s-stack-today-a070bcb345a6.



🚀 Your mission

 - Design Cross-Cutting Modules You'll transform country-specific implementations into elegant global components that will become the new building blocks of other teams to build global features

 - Remove Technical Blockers for Product Teams You’ll tackle technical blockers that cut across several domains and eliminate the need for team-specific workarounds, allowing product teams to focus on their core business

 - Orchestrate Data Transformations You'll implement strategies to harmonize different countries' data models without losing local flexibility and consolidate existing data into unified schemas

 - Build and Own What You Create You'll be responsible for the entire lifecycle of your solutions, from initial design through long-term maintenance. We don't just design — we build, deploy, and maintain what we create



🌟 Why This Role Matters

 - Focus on High-Impact, Cross-Domain Solutions You work exclusively on blockers that span multiple business domains that are heavily depended upon. This means every solution you build has an impact across multiple teams

 - Enable Teams, Don't Replace Them Your job isn't to substitute other teams or globalize everything. Instead, you'll work on technical obstacles that prevent teams from building global-first solutions and work with them to remove those obstacles

 - Learn and Share Globalization Patterns As you design and implement global solutions, you'll develop an expertise in globalization patterns. You'll share these learnings with other teams, helping them make better decisions about global vs. local solutions in their own work



🚀 What we're looking for

 - You write code and maintain what you build. At Alan there is no architect in an ivory tower, we implement what we design

 - You’re able to navigate complex systems spanning multiple business domains and technical boundaries

 - You've worked with diverse architectural patterns and can articulate the nuanced trade-offs between them

 - You can spot technical obstacles that are blocking multiple teams and design solutions that remove those obstacles


 


⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for problem-solver engineers with 5+ years of experience who get excited about simplifying complex business problems:

 - You’ll be able to tackle high-impact & high-risk projects involving many engineers.

 - You’ll design efficient systems and engineering practices to align with and facilitate interactions between multiple teams/products.

 - You’ll have the opportunity to mentor other engineers & lead crews (more details in this article https://blog.alan.com/tech-et-produit/engineering-organisation-at-alan).

 - You’ll be able to contribute to hiring your future coworkers and shape candidates’ hiring experience (improving our technical assessment process etc...)

You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you: 

 - Well-versed in Object Oriented Programming such as Python, Java, C#, and enthusiastic about web technologies such as modern Javascript.

 - Willing to work in Python/JavaScript (but you don’t need to have experience with those 2 languages!).

 - Passionate about building products.

 - Self-starting and entrepreneurial.

 - Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!).

 - Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching.

 - Fluent in English (no need to speak French!).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


THE TEAM AND YOUR MISSIONS

As Alan’s Corporate Paralegal, you will be the operational backbone of the Corporate Governance Area, owning the processes that keep our corporate governance running smoothly across a fast-growing, expanding, international group, while building the AI processes that will allow Alan to scale sustainably. Currently, the Alan group spans across six jurisdictions, and a dozen entities, and those numbers are expected to grow quickly in the coming months.



You will run our core corporate governance and legal transactions with full ownership. You will support Alan’s Corporate Governance area on entity management, corporate secretarial matters, and cross-border corporate projects. There will also be opportunities to assist with M&A or fundraising transactions.

Example of tasks include:

 - Prepare corporate documentation for Boards and General Meetings, globally, coordinating with internal teams and auditors;

 - Keep governance documentation accurate and up to date across a growing international group;

 - Handle the annual accounts closing process across our entities and maintain up to date filings, corporate formalities and reporting with authorities or auditors;

 - Be the go-to contact for shareholder or Board questions;

 - Conduct legal research and drafting with the support of other Corporate Governance area members.
   
   

You will help improve the way our work is done, by creating the governance playbook as Alan keeps growing with improved documentation, workflows, and guidance. You will branch out of pure legal work and collaborate cross-functionally with other teams where needed (Finance, People…).

Example of tasks include:

 - Help establish and maintain governance processes as Alan opens entities;

 - Build playbooks and tools to support the governance of our international entities;

 - Adapt equity frameworks and documentation to new countries and local rules.
   
   

You will automate repeatable steps and contribute to the development of a more scalable corporate governance function. You will become one of our AI builders on legal corporate matters, turning tasks into smart automated systems while preserving human review, accountability and legal quality control.

Example of tasks include:

 - Enhance the team’s autonomy by building workflows that run in the background with light human maintenance, with the support of Alan's internal tooling team where needed, using no-code/low-code platforms and Alan's internal AI system;

 - Automate recurring corporate events such as equity movements  or meeting minutes.
   
   

You will work as part of the Corporate Governance Area, led by Anne-Lise Delfanne https://www.linkedin.com/in/anne-lise-d-4a454bb/, where legal and corporate operations experts collaborate closely to orchestrate governance operations and company-wide strategic initiatives.

At Alan, we embrace that roles evolve and expand beyond their initial scope. Your journey will be filled with opportunities to grow into broader projects.




KEY OUTCOMES AFTER SIX MONTHS

By the end of the first six months, successful onboarding would mean for you to have:

 - Gained deeper understanding of Alan’s governance mechanics, equity structures and regulatory context and taken ownership of recurring governance workflows for our French entities’ governance (to start with) confidently;

 - Trained yourself to build  AI agents and workflows that remove a meaningful chunk of manual work from you and the team;

 - Built or improved internal templates and documentation to strengthen the team’s knowledge;

 - Contributed to our international expansion by opening new local entities, supporting a new filing process, or onboarding local teams on our corporate governance processes.
   
   

From then onwards, the role will grow with you, as you prove ownership on the core governance scope, you will have the opportunity to take on more diverse projects (M&A, fundraising, reorganisations, etc.).




WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This role sits at the intersection of legal knowledge, corporate operations, and AI tooling. We don't expect anyone to arrive fully skilled across all three dimensions. What matters most is your ownership mindset and genuine appetite to build. For the rest, we'll grow together.

Experience: at least 3 years as a secretarial paralegal (corporate, M&A, finance), legal assistant at a reputable international law firm or in-house at a tier-1 scale-up with comparable exposure.

 - Legal knowledge: you have completed a law degree or equivalent paralegal qualification; you have a solid understanding of corporate governance mechanics;

 - AI and tooling appetite: strong appetite to learn or already comfortable with no-code/low-code platforms (e.g. Make, Zapier, Notion automations), workflows, AI tools, and structured data;

 - Language: excellent written and spoken English (working language at Alan) and French.

Behavioural traits

 - Highly organized and rigorous, with exceptional attention to details;

 - Hands-on and self-starter: not scared of getting your hands dirty;

 - Automatization mindset: sees repetitive work as an opportunity to build something better, not just a task to complete;

 - Intellectual curiosity: genuine appetite to learn and go beyond the initial scope.
   
   

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B0-C0 level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.




🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

 

🔖 Check out our About Alan https://alan.com/about and Career https://alan.com/careers pages, as well as our Medium https://medium.com/alan, blog https://blog.alan.com/ and Glassdoor page https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm for more info.

 


YOU WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT ALAN?

🙌 Perks & Benefits https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

🤘A strong culture https://alan.com/en/about/a/leadership-principles: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

jobs.title: Fullstack Software Engineer - Sénégal 🇸🇳
jobs.description:
LA SANTÉ N'ATTEND PAS.

Que les symptômes s’aggravent. Qu'il faille 6 mois avant d’obtenir un rendez-vous. Qu'on dépende d’un système de santé englué dans le papier et les processus manuels. Et pourtant, c’est ainsi que fonctionne aujourd’hui la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest. Vous attendez, jusqu’à ne plus pouvoir attendre.

Nous existons pour mettre fin à cette attente.

Née en 2022 au Sénégal, Tanel est la première assurance santé numérique d’Afrique de l’Ouest francophone. Elle opère au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire. Nous transformons un marché dominé par les processus papier et des acteurs historiques fragmentés. Avec plus de 30 000 membres, un réseau de plus de 1 200 établissements de santé et de plus de 400 pharmacies, ainsi qu’un chiffre d'affaires multiplié par 7 en 2025, nous avons démontré une véritable adéquation entre notre produit et les besoins du marché, dans des pays qui avaient besoin d’une révolution.

En 2026, Alan, le leader européen de l’assurance santé axée sur la prévention, avec plus de 950 M€ de CA et + 1 M de membres en France, en Belgique, en Espagne et au Canada, a acquis Tanel afin d’accélérer son expansion sur le continent africain. Ensemble, nous construisons l’assurance santé de référence en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, avec l’ambition d’atteindre 200 M$ de CA d’ici 2030.

Nous réunissons le meilleur des deux mondes : l’expertise de terrain de Tanel, ses relations locales et la confiance qu’elle a su bâtir, ainsi que la plateforme technologique de pointe d’Alan, son expertise actuarielle et son expérience du déploiement dans plusieurs pays.




⭐ THE ENGINEERING TEAM ⭐

Au sein de notre équipe Engineering, nous construisons les infrastructures, les interfaces et les applications qui nous permettent d’offrir un service de premier ordre à nos membres, aux professionnels de santé et à nos propres équipes internes.

 - Être ingénieur(e) chez Alan, c’est rejoindre une équipe d’ingénieur(e)s talentueux(ses), engagé(e)s et passionné(e)s, avec une forte proximité avec le produit.

 - Nous avançons rapidement, avec un haut niveau d’autonomie, et sommes fiers de nous attaquer à des problèmes complexes.

 - Notre fonctionnement est très simple : les personnes qui prennent les décisions produit sont aussi celles qui construisent les solutions.

 - Notre stack technique repose notamment sur Python/Flask, React, React Native et PostgreSQL.

Vous souhaitez en savoir plus ? Consultez cet article https://blog.alan.com/tech-et-produit/engineering-organisation-at-alan pour découvrir le quotidien d’un(e) ingénieur(e) chez Alan, ainsi que cet article https://medium.com/alan/engineering-career-path-at-alan-e5de5c2e740c consacré à notre parcours de carrière Engineering.




⭐️ VOTRE MISSION: CONSTRUIRE LA CONVERGENCE ENTRE ALAN ET TANEL

Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la convergence progressive des produits et des technologies d’Alan et de Tanel.

L’objectif sera de préserver le meilleur de chaque organisation : la connaissance fine du marché ouest-africain, l’expertise opérationnelle et les relations locales de Tanel, ainsi que la puissance de la plateforme, les pratiques produit et l’expérience internationale d’Alan.

Vous contribuerez notamment à :

 - Faire converger les expériences produit et les fondations technologiques des deux entreprises.

 - Construire des composants et des systèmes réutilisables, capables de répondre aux besoins spécifiques des marchés locaux.

 - Faire évoluer nos outils afin d’accompagner la montée en charge du produit et des opérations.

 - Simplifier et automatiser les processus aujourd’hui gérés manuellement.

 - Améliorer la circulation et la fiabilité des données entre les équipes et les systèmes.

 - Trouver le bon équilibre entre standardisation globale et adaptation aux réalités du Sénégal et de la Côte d’Ivoire.

 - Préparer les fondations techniques nécessaires à notre expansion, à moyen terme, dans de nouveaux marchés d’Afrique de l’Ouest.

C’est une opportunité rare de travailler sur des problèmes complexes et concrets, avec un impact direct sur la manière dont la santé est financée, administrée et vécue par des milliers de personnes.

Est-ce vous que nous cherchons ?

Nous recherchons un(e) Software Engineer avec au moins trois ans d’expérience, capable de contribuer à des projets ambitieux dans un environnement en forte évolution.




VOUS SEREZ PARTICULIÈREMENT À VOTRE PLACE SI VOUS :

 - Êtes autorisé(e) à travailler au Sénégal, et êtes basé(e) à Dakar ou prêt(e) à vous y installer

 - Avez au moins 4 ans d’expérience en tant que Software Engineer. On cherche à recruter à divers niveaux de séniorité, donc les profils seniors sont bienvenus !

 - Parlez français couramment

 - Avez un anglais avancé

 - Maîtrisez un langage de programmation, comme Python, Java, C# ou équivalent.

 - Êtes à l’aise avec les technologies web modernes et souhaitez travailler sur des applications fullstack.

 - Avez l’habitude de concevoir des systèmes robustes, maintenables et évolutifs.

 - Êtes intéressé(e) par les problématiques produit et aimez comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs.

 - Êtes autonome, pragmatique et capable de prendre des décisions.

 - Aimez travailler en équipe et collaborer avec des profils non techniques.

 - Êtes à l’aise dans un environnement où les priorités peuvent évoluer rapidement.

 - Avez envie de contribuer à la construction d’une organisation technologique locale ambitieuse.

Une expérience dans l’assurance, la santé, les fintechs, les systèmes de paiement, les opérations ou les environnements réglementés serait un atout. Ce n’est toutefois pas une condition indispensable.

Nous recherchons avant tout des personnes curieuses, responsables et capables de progresser rapidement. Si vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases mais que cette mission vous enthousiasme, nous aimerions tout de même recevoir votre candidature.




🎁 AVANTAGES

 - Type de contrat : CDI (avec 3 mois de période d’essai renouvelable une fois)

 - Sur site, dans nos bureaux de Dakar, en collaboration étroite avec une équipe locale passionnée.

 - Tous les outils nécessaires pour donner le meilleur de vous-même.

 - Une assurance santé complète via Alan pour vous et votre famille.

 - Des opportunités d'apprentissage et de formation : une politique RH flexible, des budgets pour les livres et les conférences.


🎯 NOTE IMPORTANTE : NOUS RECRUTONS DES PERSONNES, PAS DES RÔLES

Si cette opportunité vous intéresse mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions ravis d'échanger avec vous. Tout le monde devrait se sentir libre de postuler !

Rappelez-vous, ceci est un guide, pas une liste exhaustive. Nous serons ravis de recevoir votre candidature.

🔖 Consultez nos pages À propos d’Alan https://alan.com/about et Carrières https://alan.com/careers, ainsi que notre page Medium https://medium.com/alan, notre blog https://blog.alan.com/ et notre page Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm pour en savoir plus.

#LI-DNP

jobs.title: Freelance Doctor (GP) - Medical Chat & Teleconsultations - Belgium
jobs.description:
Alan is looking for dedicated GPs in Belgium to help transform Healthcare together! 🌟




🐼 WHO WE ARE

Alan is not just a health insurance company; we are the health partner, dedicated to the physical and mental well-being of our members every day. Since our establishment in 2016 in France, we have expanded our services to three countries (🇫🇷, 🇧🇪, 🇪🇸) and proudly support more than 500,000 members.


Our innovative approach places equal emphasis on prevention and treatment, making healthcare more accessible and holistic.




🇧🇪 OUR SERVICES IN BELGIUM

Today we offer two services in Belgium for which we are looking for motivated family physicians:

 - Teleconsultations: Connect with our members via video call and offer medical advice from the comfort of your own home or practice. 

 - Medical Chat: Engage with our members via our medical chat service, available 7 days a week, from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. You will provide fast, accurate and personalized medical advice within a 4-hour response time. So our members get the advice, when and where they need it.

GPs can apply for either service. It is not necessary to do both.




⭐ WHY WORK FOR ALAN?

 - Innovative Healthcare: Be at the forefront of healthcare innovation, making healthcare more accessible and working with cutting-edge technologies.

 - Professional growth : discover new and innovative ways to help your patients

 - Online & Flexible Terms: Enjoy the flexibility to work from the comfort of your own home or practice, with a schedule that fits your needs as a primary care physician. A perfect complement to your existing practice!

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive and market based compensation.

 - Team of healthcare professionals: Join our dedicated team of healthcare professionals..




🤩 REQUIREMENTS

 - Certified General Practitioner: with a 003 or 004 RIZIV/INAMI number and experience in patient care.

 - Language Skills: Proficiency in Dutch required + either English or French

 - Digital Skills: Familiar with the use of digital tools.

 - Empathy & Communication: Excellent communication skills and strong empathetic approach to patient care.

 - Licensed Software: Must possess licensed prescription and attestation software.





OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS


The recruitment process consists of two stages. Each stage will provide an opportunity for you to ask questions as we want to ensure the best fit for both you and Alan.

The first interview will be with the Health Professional team coordinator at Alan, and will last approximately 30 minutes. The purpose is to get to know each other, clarify the project, and determine if your profile aligns with our needs.

The second interview (~45 minutes) will be with our Medical Lead (General Practitioner). The goal is to discuss a clinical case, and your clinical experiences and knowledge.

jobs.title: Comptable
jobs.description:
LA SANTÉ N'ATTEND PAS.

Que les symptômes s’aggravent. Qu'il faille 6 mois avant d’obtenir un rendez-vous. Qu'on dépende d’un système de santé englué dans le papier et les processus manuels. Et pourtant, c’est ainsi que fonctionne aujourd’hui la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest. Vous attendez, jusqu’à ne plus pouvoir attendre.

Née en 2022 au Sénégal, Tanel est la première assurance santé numérique d’Afrique de l’Ouest francophone. Elle opère au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire. Nous transformons un marché dominé par les processus papier et des acteurs historiques fragmentés. Avec plus de 30 000 membres, un réseau de plus de 1 200 établissements de santé et de plus de 400 pharmacies, ainsi qu’un chiffre d'affaires multiplié par 7 en 2025, nous avons démontré une véritable adéquation entre notre produit et les besoins du marché, dans des pays qui avaient besoin d’une révolution.

En 2026, Alan, le leader européen de l’assurance santé axée sur la prévention, avec plus de 950 M€ de CA et + 1 M de membres en France, en Belgique, en Espagne et au Canada, a acquis Tanel afin d’accélérer son expansion sur le continent africain. Ensemble, nous construisons l’assurance santé de référence en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, avec l’ambition d’atteindre 200 M$ de CA d’ici 2030.

Nous réunissons le meilleur des deux mondes : l’expertise de terrain de Tanel, ses relations locales et la confiance qu’elle a su bâtir, ainsi que la plateforme technologique de pointe d’Alan, son expertise actuarielle et son expérience du déploiement dans plusieurs pays.




⭐️ LA FINANCE CHEZ ALAN ⭐️

La Finance chez Alan, c’est l’équipe qui bâtit le socle financier permettant de piloter une assurance santé digitale en pleine croissance, sur des marchés où presque tout reste à construire.

Le cœur de nos responsabilités : produire une information financière fiable pour chacune de nos entités, tenir des comptes toujours prêts pour la clôture, et donner à l’entreprise les chiffres sur lesquels elle peut s’appuyer pour décider. Au quotidien, cela signifie tenir la comptabilité, saisir un volume important d’opérations sans jamais rogner sur la qualité, piloter les clôtures et pousser l’automatisation pour aller toujours plus vite.

Nous réunissons une diversité de profils :

 - Des profils qui structurent : définition du modèle de reporting, des normes et des processus financiers,

 - Des profils qui délivrent : une production comptable et un reporting d’excellence au quotidien, tout en améliorant en continu ce que nous faisons.

Nous recherchons des membres d’équipe qui aiment que les comptes soient justes, à jour et bien tenus, et qui voient dans l’automatisation un moyen de faire mieux plutôt qu’une menace.




⭐️ LE RÔLE DE COMPTABLE ⭐️

Nous recherchons un(e) comptable rigoureux(se) et rapide pour tenir la comptabilité au quotidien de nos entités en Afrique de l’Ouest. C’est un poste à fort volume : de nombreuses opérations à saisir, à rapprocher et à classer chaque jour, avec une exigence de qualité constante.

Vous travaillerez sous la responsabilité du responsable financier et en lien avec les cabinets externes. En détail, vos missions comprendront :

 - Tenir la comptabilité au quotidien : saisir les achats, ventes, encaissements et décaissements, gérer un volume élevé d’opérations dans l’outil comptable (Sage, Odoo) en respectant le plan comptable SYSCOHADA.

 - Rapprocher et contrôler : réaliser les rapprochements bancaires et de trésorerie, lettrer les comptes tiers et suivre les comptes à régulariser pour que les livres restent propres.

 - Préparer les clôtures : participer aux clôtures mensuelles dans les délais et préparer les pièces et justificatifs demandés par le responsable financier et les cabinets externes.

 - Suivre les obligations courantes : contribuer à la préparation des déclarations (TVA notamment) et au suivi des paiements, en lien avec le cabinet d’expertise-comptable.

 - Automatiser et améliorer : repérer les tâches répétitives et proposer des façons de les simplifier — imports, modèles, automatisations — pour saisir plus vite et fiabiliser la donnée. C’est un vrai plus chez nous.

Vous ferez partie d’une petite équipe finance où votre régularité et votre sens du détail comptent énormément.




⭐️ UNE OPPORTUNITÉ UNIQUE DE PARTICIPER À QUELQUE CHOSE D'HISTORIQUE ⭐️

En tant que membre de l'équipe Alan, vous serez aux avant-postes d'une véritable révolution de la santé en Afrique de l'Ouest. Vous contribuerez à bâtir la colonne vertébrale opérationnelle d'une entreprise passant de 30 000 à des centaines de milliers de membres, de deux pays à un continent entier.

Vous vivrez l'énergie d'une startup rapide, portée par ses fondateurs et en pleine croissance. Ce n'est pas un poste d'opérations ordinaire : vous opérerez sur un marché où tout est à construire, et où votre travail aura un impact direct et visible sur la vie des gens.




⭐️ VOUS ÊTES PEUT-ÊTRE LA BONNE PERSONNE SI… ⭐️

 - Vous avez au moins 3 ans d’expérience en comptabilité, idéalement sur un poste à fort volume de saisie.

 - Vous maîtrisez le plan comptable SYSCOHADA / OHADA et les écritures courantes, ainsi qu’un logiciel comptable (Sage, Odoo ou équivalent).

 - Vous êtes rapide, rigoureux(se) et fiable : vous produisez du volume sans laisser passer d’erreurs.

 - Vous êtes à l’aise avec les tableurs (Excel / Google Sheets) et curieux(se) des outils qui font gagner du temps.

 - Vous êtes autonome, organisé(e) et respectueux(se) des délais.

 - Vous êtes à l’aise en français ; des notions d’anglais sont un plus.
   
   

C’est encore mieux si vous avez :

 - Une expérience en assurance santé, en mutuelle (IPM/mutuelle) ou en cabinet d’expertise-comptable.

 - Une appétence marquée pour l’automatisation : macros, scripts, imports, ou tout moyen de réduire la saisie manuelle.

 - Une expérience de la fiscalité locale (TVA) au Sénégal ou en Côte d’Ivoire.




🎁 AVANTAGES

 - Type de contrat : CDI.

 - Sur site, dans nos bureaux de Dakar, en collaboration étroite avec une équipe locale passionnée.

 - Tous les outils nécessaires pour donner le meilleur de vous-même.

 - Une assurance santé complète via Alan pour vous et votre famille.

 - Des opportunités d'apprentissage et de formation : une politique flexible, des budgets pour les livres et les conférences.




🎯 NOTE IMPORTANTE : NOUS RECRUTONS DES PERSONNES, PAS DES RÔLES.

Si cette opportunité vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions ravis d'échanger avec vous. Toutes les personnes, y compris celles issues de groupes sous-représentés, devraient se sentir libres de postuler : soit on réussit, soit on apprend. Rappelez-vous, ceci est un guide, pas une liste exhaustive. #LI-DNP

jobs.title: Fullstack Software Engineer (x/f/m) - Claims Management
jobs.description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


🚀 WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You would join the team called “Claims Management”, in charge of refunding €350M+ of healthcare expenses every year to 1.1M+ members across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada.

Our mission is to refund each member as fast as we can and the right amount, while being cost-effective for Alan.

We have internalized all the critical parts to handle health claims, which makes this product division a technical, deep, and exciting place to work.

Claims Management contains several product crews:

 - Claims processing https://medium.com/alan/how-we-reached-70-document-processing-automation-at-alan-674bc80f3ef3: 2.5M documents received every year. We automatically parse a good portion of them with LLMs but we want to go further.

 - Claims experience https://medium.com/alan/universalisation-at-alan-how-we-stopped-building-everything-twice-7feb8d88a4a8: Building the most memorable and straightforward experience for our members to understand their guarantees and get a claim refunded. Across 4 different countries, mobile and desktop.

 - Global coverage: the engine that decides the right amount, everywhere. Modelling guarantees, care types and coverage rules once, globally, so a member understands what they are covered for before they even spend.

 - Payments: Building a payment infra & source ingestion system to make sure our members get refunded super fast or better, they don’t need to advance the money.

 - Fraud fighting: 6M€ saved in 2025 with an internal stack combining Machine learning scoring, anomaly detections, and manual investigations

 - Claims platform: owns the compute backbone of claims processing: orchestration, queues, concurrency, capacity and performance observability. The mission is to make cost grow with the volume and complexity of claims processed, not with member volume or member history.





⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for engineers with 5+ years of experience who get excited about building complex systems that need to work perfectly 24/7 every day of the year despite being on a high-growth trajectory.

We value:

 - Passionate about creating delightful products with exceptional user experiences, you understand what it takes to build delightful user experiences at scale.

 - Good experience building and shipping web applications

 - You're genuinely interested in the business side - understanding conversion funnels, marketing metrics, and what drives growth

 - Clear progression in your career  https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/why-i-left-12-years-comfort-claims-management-beno%C3%AEt-prioux-vwy8e/?trackingId=xM9PPDzES9miIKNSYPPhhg%3D%3D- increasing responsibility, scope, and impact over time.

 - Open to working with TypeScript and Python in a cross-platform environment, familiar with modern web technologies, and proficient in Object-Oriented Programming (Python, Java, Swift, Kotlin, or C#).

 - Self-starting and entrepreneurial.

 - Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!).

 - Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching.

 - English working proficiency

Mission Alignment:

 - Healthcare technology excites you

 - Leveraging AI to redefine our roles and unlock scalability
   
   


⭐ THE ENGINEERING TEAM ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is React, Python/Flask, PostgreSQL in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.

Want to know more? Read this article https://blog.alan.com/tech-et-produit/engineering-organisation-at-alan if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article https://medium.com/alan/engineering-career-path-at-alan-e5de5c2e740c on our Engineering career path.



🌍 HOW WE WORK

Location: You must be legally eligible to work in France, Belgium, or Spain.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration




🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor pages for more info.




YOU WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT ALAN?

 - 🙌 Perks & Benefits https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

 - 🤘 A strong culture https://alan.com/en/about/a/leadership-principles: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work



🔄 A quick note about the process
Note: While you're applying for a specific area, you may join a different engineering team based on where we think you'll have the most impact. Check out descriptions of other areas here https://www.notion.so/alaninsurance/Software-Engineering-Areas-Alan-2c61426e8be7805bacd2cdbc08c32640?source=copy_link.

🧩 CONTEXT OF THE ROLE

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

 - Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

 - Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

 - Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).




🎯 YOUR MISSION

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

 - Business Strategy
   
   - Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan
   
   - Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)
   
   - Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

 - Sales & Account Manager Planning
   
   - Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy
   
   - Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

 - Performance monitoring & Steering
   
   - Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions
   
   - Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis
   
   - Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)
     
     


🧐 SKILLS WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.



At least 3 years of experience within either:

 - Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

 - Management consulting, investment banking or private equity
   
   

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

 - Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

 - Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

 - Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

 - Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company
   
   

Business sense:

 - At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

 - Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones
   
   

Communication and presence:

 - Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

 - Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

 - Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

 - Great written and oral structure and communication

 - Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

 - Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris or Barcelona area
   
   

Nice to have

 - Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

 - Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

 - Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.




🙌 PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan/a/perks

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

 - Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

 - Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or Barcelona office

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

 - Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

 - Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

 - Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

 - Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.
   
   


IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Alan's Corporate team brings together Risk, Internal Control, Legal, Compliance, Corporate Governance and Security around a shared mission: building the infrastructure that lets Alan operate at scale, safely and responsibly. Internal Control helps design, implement and monitor controls within the business so operations run in line with members' interests, the strategy, our objectives and the law.



We are looking for a high-potential risk and internal control professional who can define and own control activities end-to-end, and grow into ownership of more complex control scopes over time.



This is not a traditional, box-checking control role. We build solutions and act as genuine business partners on risks. This is an opportunity to be part of the next generation of risk professionals: developing automated controls, documentation and using AI to detect emerging risks early.




⭐️ YOUR MISSIONS ⭐️

 - Internal Control
   
   - You will define and implement control frameworks on processes, leveraging Alan’s culture of transparency and distributed ownership, and pushing for reliability and scalability: AI and automation, smart processes
   
   - You will help strengthening our system for identifying and monitoring risks and co-build the next generation of risk tooling
   
   - You will perform second-level reviews on high-risk areas
   
   - You will drive efforts to ensure proper controls documentation and communicability to third parties partners
   
   - You will support the management of audits from commercial partners and supervisors

 - Team growth
   
   - You will help expand risk management reflexes throughout the company, and assist teams such as Insurance, Operations, Security and Legal to design and implement action plans to mitigate our risks
   
   - You will create resources to raise awareness and empower the team for risk management, internal control and regulatory compliance;
   
   - You will support the identification and hiring of new talents for the team.

 - At least two years of experience in internal control or a risk function - in insurance, a Big Four, or a regulated / fast-growing environment

En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé.

 - 🎯 Des programmes de prévention (mal de dos, gestion du stress) : guidés et personnalisés

Nous recrutons des médecins généralistes à l'aise avec le soin à distance et motivé(e)s pour nous rejoindre sur notre service de téléconsultation. Ce qui compte pour nous autant que vos compétences médicales : votre capacité à créer une relation de confiance à distance, avec bienveillance et sans compromis sur la qualité des soins.

 - ✅ Statut salarié

 - ✅ Convaincu(e) que prévention et accompagnement changent vraiment la vie des patients

Des médecins référents vous accompagnent dans les situations cliniques difficiles, des pairs sont disponibles pour échanger, et vous pouvez solliciter des spécialistes de l'équipe comme dans une vraie structure de soin.

Vous pouvez accorder le temps qu'il faut à chaque patient, sans pression sur le nombre de consultations.

 - Corporate & Governance - Support the constitution of our board packs, public affairs work, legal research, fundraisings, key Alaners meetings.

 - Brand & Communication - Develop the corporate presence at major events, via social networks; organise internal and external events to build the Alan network and leverage connections globally.

 - Talent - Sourcing and recruiting the next batch of FA’s

 - Strategy - Develop market entry strategies for international expansion, contribute RFP coordination for major prospects in the public sector, create go-to-market plans for new segments.

 - Product - Assist in the development of core products in Alan’s offering (ex: Alan Walk), exploring opportunities to streamline the user experience market research to evaluate the opportunity to build new services within Alan

You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 - Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure);

 - Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives;

 - Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

 - Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

 - Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them.

 - Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

 - Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

 - Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

 - Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

 - Have at least an advanced level in English.

 - Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

⭐️ THE BUSINESS SEGMENT LEAD ROLE ⭐️

At Alan, we split the French market in several business segments, each of them corresponding to a category of clients (whether by size, or industry).



The role of a Business Segment Lead is to reach market leadership in their given segment. To succeed, you will have to (1) articulate a vision for your segment, (2) define priorities and resources to deliver, and (3) make strategic decisions for your segment based on market insights.



The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing). You will also collaborate with other segment leaders to build-up knowledge, share best practices, and create alignment around a long-term value plan.




MAIN MISSIONS INCLUDE:

 - Market intelligence: You’ll build expertise on our market and competitive landscape. You’ll work both on the quantitative side (sizing) and the qualitative side (customers’ pain points and needs).

 - Value proposition and pricing: Our goal is to differentiate our offer from the market. You’ll relentlessly ask yourself: what is the best product offering to become leader in this segment?

 - Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management.

 - P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L.

 - Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights.




WE ARE CURRENTLY HIRING FOR NEW SEGMENTS:

 - It gathers several, high potential sub-segments where everything is to be built.

 - We will focus heavily on those new opportunities in the coming years.




⭐️ IF YOU HAVE SOME OF THE FOLLOWING, YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT ⭐️

 - At least 8 years of prior experience leading a business (product category, business segment, etc.)

 - Full working proficiency in French

 - At least advanced level in English

 - An exceptional ability to establish transversal influence

 - Used to analyze and manipulate data to build a 360 degree view of your market

 - A strong business sense while being able to go deep into product considerations

 - Able to articulate clear strategies in spite of complexity/uncertainty

 - A prior experience working with senior leadership

 - You are a generalist self-starter (Vs a specialist of 1 single  industry) able to adapt fast and not afraid to go on the field to support your team mates and learn from them

 - You are based in (or willing to relocate to) either Paris, Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.



For this role, we are looking to hire within the E-F level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity. 




🙌 PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan/a/perks

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

 - Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

 - Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

 - Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

 - Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

 - Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

jobs.description:
