Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.




🤖 OPS AI PLATFORM TEAM 🔀

We're building something that doesn't exist yet.

Imagine a platform where AI agents autonomously handle operational work - connected to every internal and external tool, trained by operators themselves, running safely at scale. No engineers needed. No bottlenecks. Just agents that work.

That's what we're building. The Ops AI Platform will let our Ops team create, evolve, and monitor their own AI agents to automate thousands of tedious tasks. We aim to crack problems no one has solved at this scale.

The project just launched. You'd join at ground zero - shaping the architecture, the product, the entire foundation.

If building the future of work from scratch excites you, this is it.




⭐ OUR NORTH STAR

We’re building ops agents that work reliably and safely, without putting the engineering team on the critical path.

You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering and ML engineering. Our mission is to create the platform that enables building accurate and reliable AI agents, delivering an outstanding experience to our internal Ops team for the creation, iteration and monitoring of their agents, without requiring hard technical skills. Things we’re working on:

 - 💬 Integrate agents at the heart of internal tools - UIs where Ops monitor and take action on concrete business situations. We want AI agents to become first-class citizens in this ecosystem, with context-aware chat modals, allowing users to review agents' reasoning, actions, and provide follow-up instructions - with instant impact on business data.

 - 👥 Empower non-technical users to become autonomous in the creation and maintenance of agents to automate operational tasks at scale: prompting, tools configuration, testing, datasets, replayability, evaluations

 - 🔧 Build a complete set of tools made available to AI agents, connecting to internal and external capabilities: internal business data, external servers, external web dashboards without API, etc.

 - 💯 Safety and accuracy at the core: robust testing, stateful evaluation, progressive rollout, human-in-the-loop to validate sensitive actions, fine-grained permissions and limits

In 6 to 12 months, we plan to increase our scope by owning the AI platform that will power all agentic use cases at Alan - creating economies of scale thanks to common infrastructure and tooling.

If you’re excited by the idea of building the future of work, this is the team for you - we're at the start of the journey.




🎯 IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

We’re looking for Product engineers with 3+ years of experience who get excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in operations.

 - You’ll work at the frontier of LLMs, tool calling, human-in-the-loop, internal tools UX, multi-agent architectures, and see your work deployed in production, used by our ops team

 - You’ll implement new capabilities for AI agents, as well as tooling to make ops autonomous on the creation, evolution, monitoring and evaluation of their agents

 - You’ll work on making our system scale, going from a few dozen to tens of thousands of tasks automated daily

 - You’ll have significant influence on system architecture and code quality

 - You’ll mentor engineers, contribute to our product & engineering culture, and help build the team (including participating in hiring).

You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

 - Strong background in full-stack software engineering, systems architecture, with a spike in back-end engineering.

 - Experience with traditional ML, or LLMs, or ML dev ops is a big plus

 - Product-minded: you want your solutions to be used, and impactful

 - Self-directed and pragmatic

 - Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!)

 - Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching

 - Fluent in English (no need to speak French!)

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.




🙌   PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your  time as you  wish.

 - Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

 - Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly  flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

 - Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

 - Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.




IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

Founding the function

 - Handle directly the member contacts that stay in-house: admin requests, escalations, complex cases.

 - Write the scripts, guidelines, and documentation that make Care work in Saudi from day one.

 - Shape the operating model on the ground together with the GM Saudi and the global Care community: opening hours, shift coverage, tooling setup (Intercom and others), and how traffic splits between in-house and externalized support.

What success looks like: a documented, working Care operation that can pass regulatory scrutiny and handle real member conversations from launch.



Owning quality on externalized support

 - Own the quality bar for everything we externalize: review calls and tickets in Arabic, coach our outsourcing partner's agents, and close the loop between what members experience and what we improve.

What success looks like: externalized conversations meet Alan's quality bar, and gaps get caught and fixed before they become member complaints.



Owning regulatory accountability

 - Own the complaint-handling policy and the regulatory SLAs on complaints.

 - Prepare the documentation and readiness for the Insurance Authority inspection.

What success looks like: Alan passes Insurance Authority inspection with a clear, accountable answer on every complaint-handling question asked.



You won't be building this alone. You'll have the full support of Alan's global Care Ops team on process design, tooling, forecasting, and planning, the same team behind our Care launches in France, Belgium, and Canada. You bring the on-the-ground execution and Arabic-language expertise; they bring the playbooks and cross-market experience.




👀 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - You are a founding operator. You've built an operational function from scratch before, or you're ready to do it for the first time with real ownership.

 - You are hands-on in ambiguity. You're happy to answer tickets yourself on day one while designing the system in parallel. Some decisions on coverage model and tooling are still being finalized, and you'll help make them.

 - You are AI-first. You're excited to work on automation and tooling, not just process.

 - You lead with ownership and directness. You hold an outsourcing partner accountable to a quality bar without hesitation.

 - You are genuinely energized by great customer experience. When a member is frustrated, you don't just close the ticket, you make sure they walk away feeling cared for.

 - You understand the member's stakes. Ideally, you've seen pre-authorization, claims, or member frustration points up close, in health insurance, health services, or a comparable regulated environment.

Must-haves

 - Saudi national.

 - Fluent in Arabic and English, spoken and written. Both are mandatory: Arabic for the QA work on Arabic-language conversations, English for collaboration with the global Care community and cross-functional teams.

 - Comfortable operating with significant ambiguity: building the system and doing the work at the same time.

 - Strong ownership and directness, including holding an external partner accountable to a quality bar.

 - Genuine interest in AI-first tooling and automation.

Nice-to-haves

 - Health insurance, health services, or financial services background; understanding of pre-authorization, claims, and member frustration points in Saudi Arabia.

 - Experience building or scaling an operational/support function from scratch.

 - Familiarity with the Saudi regulatory environment (Insurance Authority requirements).

Level target: B1-C1 on Alan's level grid.

 - Real ownership and impact from day one, on a function you build yourself.

 - As the team scales, this role has the potential to grow into leading a local team.

jobs.title: Médecin du travail
jobs.description:
🐼 POURQUOI PRÉVENIR

Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France.

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé, en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan.

Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début !

👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici https://prevenir.fr/carrieres




🩺 LE POSTE, CONCRÈTEMENT

Vous êtes médecin du travail référent sur un portefeuille d'entreprises adhérentes, vos responsabilités sont les suivantes: 

 - Coordonner les trois missions des SPSTI (suivi individuel, action en milieu de travail, prévention de la désinsertion professionnelle) sur votre périmètre d'entreprises adhérentes, avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire que vous animez : IDEST, ASST, IPRP

 - Innovation et amélioration continue: test et déploiement de nouveaux outils numériques en santé au travail, optimisation des protocoles, collaboration avec les équipes de développement, etc.

Ce qui change vs. un SPSTI classique :

 - Une délégation réelle. L'équipe pluridisciplinaire et les IDEST prennent en charge ce qui peut l'être. Vous concentrez votre temps médical là où il a le plus d'impact.

 - La téléconsultation à la demande du salarié, intégrée à votre pratique quand elle est cliniquement pertinente.

 - Des outils numériques co-construits en fonction de vos attentes. Une équipe d'ingénieurs et de designers Alan développe avec les médecins les outils dont ils ont besoin — DMST, parcours de prévention, assistance à la rédaction de fiche d'entreprises, etc. 




👤 LE PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Indispensable :

 - Doctorat en médecine + DES ou CES de médecine du travail

 - Inscription à l'Ordre

Idéalement :

 - Goût pour le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire et la délégation 

 - Curiosité pour les outils numériques et l'IA appliqués à la pratique médicale

 - Capacité à construire une relation de confiance avec salariés et adhérents

Vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases ? Postulez quand même. Médecins en reconversion, jeunes diplômé·es, profils internationaux... n'hésitez pas à nous contacter !




💚 CE QU'ON OFFRE

 - Lieu : 117 quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) - dans un centre tout neuf, pensé pour la qualité de l'exercice médical

 - Rémunération selon profil, transparente et benchmarkée

 - Plan d'intéressement

 - Temps plein ou temps partiel (à discuter)

 - RTT

 - Prise en charge du transport quotidien

 - Restaurant d'entreprise

 - Formation linguistique offerte

 - Événements d'équipe réguliers

Pour en savoir plus sur notre politique salariale, c'est ici https://alaninsurance.notion.site/Politique-salariale-Pr-venir-1b21426e8be780d497cadc6220862475 !

jobs.title: Directeur Financier - Afrique de l'Ouest
jobs.description:
LA SANTÉ N'ATTEND PAS.

Que les symptômes s’aggravent. Qu'il faille 6 mois avant d’obtenir un rendez-vous. Qu'on dépende d’un système de santé englué dans le papier et les processus manuels. Et pourtant, c’est ainsi que fonctionne aujourd’hui la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest. Vous attendez, jusqu’à ne plus pouvoir attendre.

Nous existons pour mettre fin à cette attente.

Née en 2022 au Sénégal, Tanel est la première assurance santé numérique d’Afrique de l’Ouest francophone. Elle opère au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire. Nous transformons un marché dominé par les processus papier et des acteurs historiques fragmentés. Avec plus de 30 000 membres, un réseau de plus de 1 200 établissements de santé et de plus de 400 pharmacies, ainsi qu’un chiffre d'affaires multiplié par 7 en 2025, nous avons démontré une véritable adéquation entre notre produit et les besoins du marché, dans des pays qui avaient besoin d’une révolution.

En 2026, Alan, le leader européen de l’assurance santé axée sur la prévention, avec plus de 950 M€ de CA et + 1 M de membres en France, en Belgique, en Espagne et au Canada, a acquis Tanel afin d’accélérer son expansion sur le continent africain. Ensemble, nous construisons l’assurance santé de référence en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, avec l’ambition d’atteindre 200 M$ de CA d’ici 2030.

Nous réunissons le meilleur des deux mondes : l’expertise de terrain de Tanel, ses relations locales et la confiance qu’elle a su bâtir, ainsi que la plateforme technologique de pointe d’Alan, son expertise actuarielle et son expérience du déploiement dans plusieurs pays.




⭐️ LA FINANCE CHEZ ALAN ⭐️

La Finance chez Alan, c’est l’équipe qui bâtit le socle financier permettant de piloter une assurance santé digitale en pleine croissance, sur des marchés où presque tout reste à construire.

Le cœur de nos responsabilités : produire une information financière fiable pour chacune de nos entités, tenir des comptes toujours prêts pour la clôture, et donner à l’entreprise les chiffres sur lesquels elle peut s’appuyer pour décider. Au quotidien, cela signifie tenir la comptabilité, piloter les clôtures, coordonner les cabinets externes, suivre la trésorerie et pousser l’automatisation dans un contexte multi-pays et multi-devises.

Nous réunissons une diversité de profils :

 - Des profils qui structurent : définition du modèle de reporting, des normes et des processus financiers,

 - Des profils qui délivrent : une production comptable et un reporting d’excellence au quotidien, tout en améliorant en continu ce que nous faisons.

Nous recherchons des membres d’équipe prêts à instaurer des standards financiers de classe mondiale sur des marchés qui les méritent, et à en faire un véritable avantage.




⭐️ LE RÔLE DE DIRECTEUR FINANCIER ⭐️

Nous recherchons un(e) responsable financier(ère) expérimenté(e) et opérationnel(le) pour porter l’ensemble de la fonction finance de nos activités en Afrique de l’Ouest.

Vous serez le point unique de responsabilité sur la façon dont ce périmètre est piloté et reporté. Basé(e) à Dakar, vous ferez le lien entre les équipes locales, les cabinets externes et la maison-mère. En détail, vos missions comprendront :

 - Piloter le reporting de l’ensemble du périmètre : produire chaque mois le compte de résultat, le bilan et la situation de trésorerie de chaque entité et les intégrer proprement dans le reporting mensuel global.

 - Coordonner les comptables et les cabinets : animer une équipe de comptables et la relation avec les cabinets d’expertise-comptable externes de chaque entité — fixer le calendrier de clôture, revoir leurs livrables et tenir le niveau de qualité.

 - Piloter la clôture et les contrôles : assurer une clôture mensuelle fiable sur l’ensemble des entités et des devises (FCFA et USD), porter les rapprochements et mettre en place les contrôles nécessaires à mesure que l’activité se rapproche de comptes prêts pour l’audit.

 - Assurer le lien avec la maison-mère : être l’interlocuteur(rice) finance du groupe — traduire les réalités locales en standards de reporting, répondre aux demandes de données et soutenir la consolidation.

 - Améliorer, automatiser et faire grandir l’équipe : challenger et fluidifier les processus financiers pour réduire le travail manuel et accélérer le reporting, et participer au recrutement, à l’onboarding et à la montée en compétences de l’équipe finance locale.

Vous travaillerez en grande autonomie, en collaboration étroite avec les équipes centrales Finance, Data et Trésorerie.




⭐️ UNE OPPORTUNITÉ UNIQUE DE PARTICIPER À QUELQUE CHOSE D'HISTORIQUE ⭐️

En tant que membre de l'équipe Alan, vous serez aux avant-postes d'une véritable révolution de la santé en Afrique de l'Ouest. Vous contribuerez à bâtir la colonne vertébrale opérationnelle d'une entreprise passant de 30 000 à des centaines de milliers de membres, de deux pays à un continent entier.

Vous vivrez l'énergie d'une startup rapide, portée par ses fondateurs et en pleine croissance. Ce n'est pas un poste d'opérations ordinaire : vous opérerez sur un marché où tout est à construire, et où votre travail aura un impact direct et visible sur la vie des gens.




⭐️ VOUS ÊTES PEUT-ÊTRE LA BONNE PERSONNE SI… ⭐️

 - Vous avez plus de 6 ans d’expérience en comptabilité/finance, avec une réelle responsabilité dans une clôture multi-entités.

 - Vous maîtrisez les normes SYSCOHADA / OHADA et la fiscalité locale (TVA, IS/BIC).

 - Vous avez fait vos preuves dans le management de comptables et de cabinets externes, la définition de standards et la tenue d’un calendrier de production, vous faites fonctionner un dispositif financier distribué dans les délais.

 - Vous êtes rigoureux(se), autonome, proactif(ve) et orienté(e) solution.

 - Vous êtes un(e) excellent(e) communicant(e), à l’aise pour faire le pont entre des équipes locales et des interlocuteurs internationaux.

 - Vous êtes parfaitement à l’aise en français et en anglais (langue de travail du groupe).
   
   

C’est encore mieux si vous avez :

 - Une expérience en assurance santé, en mutuelle (IPM/mutuelle) ou dans un environnement de gestion pour compte de tiers (TPA).

 - Une bonne connaissance de l’environnement réglementaire au Sénégal ou en Côte d’Ivoire ; une expérience de consolidation (US GAAP ou IFRS/normes françaises) est un plus.

 - Des compétences en data et en automatisation pour fiabiliser et accélérer le reporting.




🎁 AVANTAGES

 - Type de contrat : CDI.

 - Sur site, dans nos bureaux de Dakar, en collaboration étroite avec une équipe locale passionnée.

 - Tous les outils nécessaires pour donner le meilleur de vous-même.

 - Une assurance santé complète via Alan pour vous et votre famille.

 - Des opportunités d'apprentissage et de formation : une politique flexible, des budgets pour les livres et les conférences.




🎯 NOTE IMPORTANTE : NOUS RECRUTONS DES PERSONNES, PAS DES RÔLES.

Si cette opportunité vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions ravis d'échanger avec vous. Toutes les personnes, y compris celles issues de groupes sous-représentés, devraient se sentir libres de postuler : soit on réussit, soit on apprend. Rappelez-vous, ceci est un guide, pas une liste exhaustive. #LI-DNP

📍JOIN ALAN’S OPERATIONS TEAM IN LYON



The Operations Coordinator works on a specific subset of services we deliver (eg. claim reimbursement, fraud, clinic to name a few) .

 - Run our Insurance or Health services processes - that's why we call them Ops Runners internally 😉

 - Ensure the day-to-day follow up and monitoring of our operations

 - Flag risks and opportunities

In details, your missions are:

 - Operating our processes: performing tasks like invoicing or claims treatment, growing and managing our network of providers, supporting internal teams (live and through documentation)

 - Contributing to the definition & owning the best monitoring scheme to track volumes/efficiency/SLAs, and identify risks and areas of improvement, internally or with our service providers

 - Supervising partnerships (e.g. teleconsultation, claim operators), participating in the negotiation rounds, daily communication to ensure business continuity

 - Performing controls on our daily operations to make sure the correct decisions were made and to identify training needs (internally as well as externally)

 - Escalating feedback, helping to prioritise and supporting initiatives to make our processes and services more delightful and efficient

Next to running and monitoring our operations, you implement continuous improvements to our processes (+-20/30% of the time). ⭐️ OUR RUN ORGANISATION ⭐️

Alan therapy: members can book a therapy session with psychologists. You maintain smooth relationships with our psychologists, ensure therapy demand  matches the supply and contribute to several steps of their lifecycle at Alan (hiring, onboarding, invoicing, supporting booking management etc).

Set up:  We provide best-in-class experience to our Customers : a smooth on/offboarding of their employees and a seamless invoicing or billing. Finance & Strategy exists to enable better decisions, faster, at every level of the company, in a regulated, diverse and ever changing business.

We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance.

We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change.

We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision making processes and challenge the status quo.

 

The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are:

 - Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing

 - Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance.

 - Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking

 - Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A




⭐️ YOUR MISSION ⭐️

We are looking for a rigorous and hands-on accountant to help shape and run Alan's closing production process.

You will be part of our Financial Reporting area, focusing on Financial production.  This area ensures that every number in our books is accurate, timely, and trustworthy, and serves as the source of truth for all financial decisions across the company.

Your role will be twofold:

 - Run our key accounting processes: Lead monthly, quarterly, and year-end closings

 - Ensure a feedback loop to drive process improvements, surface anomalies, flag data gaps, and actively contribute to making the closing faster, more automated, and more reliable over time. You will be a key partner to our Financial Operations and Data teams.

 


⭐️ WHAT YOU WILL DO ⭐️

 - Month-end close: own the end-to-end closing cycle across multiple legal entities; push pre-formatted journal entries into NetSuite, ensure completeness and accuracy, and deliver on schedule every month (target: J+5)

 - Accounting review: perform a thorough first-level review of balance sheet and P&L accounts at each close; identify unusual movements, resolve discrepancies, and ensure the overall reliability of the financial statements; build processes (routines, verification files, control procedures)

 - Account and bank reconciliation: maintain clean, up-to-date reconciliations across all balance sheet accounts and entities on a daily basis;

 - Contribute to finance transformation and system improvements: identify manual or repetitive tasks and collaborate with Financial Data to drive automation and reduce closing friction over time ; translate new business streams and P&L lines into accounting (acting as an interface between business teams and Finance)

 - Tax and statutory compliance: prepare and file VAT returns, URSSAF declarations, and other statutory filings accurately and on time; coordinate with external advisors where needed




⭐️ QUALIFICATIONS ⭐️

Experience and technical skills

 - 4 to 6 years of accounting experience minimum, in an accounting firm or in-house at a fast-paced startup/scale-up

 - Languages: full fluency in French and English

 - Deep command of French accounting standards: VAT rules, URSSAF declarations, bank reconciliation, general ledger management, and month-end close processes

 - Proven ability to own a closing cycle end-to-end, including identifying and resolving issues independently

 - Hands-on experience with an ERP (NetSuite is a strong plus)

 - Comfortable with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel); familiarity with modern accounting tools (Pennylane, Payflows, etc.) is a plus

 

Mindset and soft skills

 - Reliable and detail-oriented: you deliver on time, every time, and keep a clean audit trail

 - Autonomous and self-directed: you don't wait to be told what to do next; you manage your priorities, make decisions independently, and know how to take a step back to distinguish what truly matters from day-to-day noise

 - Process-driven: you naturally question how things are done and come with concrete ideas to improve them

 - Curious about automation and tooling; comfortable working in a data-driven environment

 - Clear communicator: you know when to move independently and when to escalate



For this role we are looking to hire within the B0-C0 level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

 - You'll partner and align with all parts of the business: Marketing, Sales, Brand, and Data.



About the Growth area

Growth owns everything that happens before someone becomes a member: how prospects find Alan, how they decide we're right for them, and how they start. It runs across two crews.

 - Conversion: the conversion flows and referral surfaces that turn prospects into members.

 - Growth Infrastructure: the website, marketing measurement, and marketing ops that make growth marketing efficient.

You'll own the product across both crews. You'll set the overarching product vision, manage the PMs, push experimentation velocity, and lead Alan's move to make Growth Product AI-native.



More specifically, this means the following.



Lead Alan's AI ambition in Growth

The way people discover and buy insurance is about to change, and we want Alan ahead of it. You'll set the agenda and ship against it:

 - Conversational AI that guides prospects through our sales flows.

 - AI-native acquisition surfaces.

 - Alan inside LLM ecosystems. Picture a GPT app where a prospect can shop for and buy health insurance, and agentic commerce more broadly.

You don't need to have built all of this before. You do need a real, opinionated view of where AI is going, and the drive to turn it into shipped product rather than decks.



Build an experimentation engine

Conversion is won by learning faster than anyone else.

We have achieved a first baseline of A/B testing, learning loops, and a clear shared bar for what actually counts as a win. Now we want to take it to the next level. You'll improve our experimentation culture and the velocity.



Give the area a coherent vision

You'll align the Conversion and Growth Infrastructure roadmaps and concentrate the team's bets where the leverage is.

Two bigger shifts sit in your scope. Alan is going from one product to many, and Growth needs to move from a single conversion flow toward something modular. We're also scaling a self-served model built to travel fast, so it can reach a new country quickly with controlled local adaptation.



Build the team

You'll manage the PMs in the area and contribute to people topics for all product communities in the area (Design, Engineering, Data, Insurance). jobs.description:
⭐ LA SANTÉ N’ATTEND PAS ⭐

Que les symptômes s’aggravent. Qu’il faille six mois avant d’obtenir un rendez-vous. Qu’on dépende d’un système de santé englué dans le papier et les processus manuels. Et pourtant, c’est ainsi que fonctionne aujourd’hui la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest. Vous attendez, jusqu’à ne plus pouvoir attendre.

Nous existons pour mettre fin à cette attente.

Née en 2022 au Sénégal, Tanel est la première assurance santé numérique d’Afrique de l’Ouest francophone. Elle opère au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire. Nous transformons un marché dominé par les processus papier et des acteurs historiques fragmentés. Avec plus de 30 000 membres, un réseau de plus de 1 200 établissements de santé et de plus de 400 pharmacies, ainsi qu’un chiffre d’affaires multiplié par sept en 2025, nous avons démontré une véritable adéquation entre notre produit et les besoins du marché, dans des pays qui avaient besoin d’une révolution.

En 2026, Alan, le leader européen de l’assurance santé axée sur la prévention, avec plus de 950 M€ de chiffre d’affaires et plus d’un million de membres en France, en Belgique, en Espagne et au Canada, a acquis Tanel afin d’accélérer son expansion sur le continent africain. Ensemble, nous construisons l’assurance santé de référence en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, avec l’ambition d’atteindre 200 M$ de chiffre d’affaires d’ici 2030.

Nous réunissons le meilleur des deux mondes : l’expertise de terrain de Tanel, ses relations locales et la confiance qu’elle a su bâtir, ainsi que la plateforme technologique de pointe d’Alan, son expertise actuarielle et son expérience du déploiement dans plusieurs pays.

Les personnes qui rejoignent Alan sont souvent surprises et ravies par notre méthode de travail innovante. Nous avons défini un ensemble de valeurs culturelles https://alan.com/about/company-culture qui guident notre façon de travailler.



💡 LA MISSION

Alan se développe rapidement en Afrique et nous recherchons une personne pour prendre en charge l’expérience Workplace au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire.

Vous contribuerez à faire des bureaux des environnements agréables, efficaces et bien organisés, tout en créant des moments qui renforcent le lien entre les Alaners.

 - Gérer les opérations quotidiennes des bureaux de Dakar et d’Abidjan : espaces, fournitures, équipements, accès, courrier et services.

 - Coordonner les fournisseurs, les achats, les factures et les sujets de maintenance.

 - Organiser les événements locaux, les moments d’équipe, les offsites et les rituels de communauté.

 - Accompagner les Alaners en déplacement entre les différents hubs, notamment sur les sujets de transport et de logistique.

jobs.title: Founding engineer- Mo team (AI Health Companion)
jobs.description:
🤖 WHO WE ARE

We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone.

We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖.

We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.




🚀 WHAT KEEPS US UP AT NIGHT

We’re building a medical agent that works — reliably, safely, and at scale.

You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. Our mission is to build the most accurate and reliable medical agent in the world, while delivering an outstanding conversational experience. Things we’re working on:

 - 💬 Deliver the most memorable chatting experience — You’ll work on making Mo the obvious choice when it comes to asking a health question. It means having a world-class snappy and delightful chatting experience, blazing fast time to answer, and rich content shared.

 - 🧱 Integrate Mo with Alan services and our healthcare system — You’ll work on integrating Mo with our other services (digital chat with HP, map of physical location of HPs, tailored prevention programs, …) to help members get from words to actions.

 - ➕ Extend our architecture to support the next chapters of Mo — You’ll work on our architecture, and agentic framework, to support Mo’s next needs (get more context, use new skills, be accessible in other countries we operate in)



If you’re excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you - we're at the start of the journey. If you’re curious, here https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.12808 is a paper we published recently.


 


🎯 IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

We’re looking for Product engineers with 3+ years of experience who get excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

 - You’ll work at the frontier of LLMs, multi-agent architectures, and human-in-the-loop learning — and see your work deployed in production, helping real people.

 - You’ll implement new capabilities for Mo, working across engineering, data, and medical expertise

 - You'll have deep product ownership over the use cases supported in Mo, making sure we actually help our members get and stay better.

 - You’ll have significant influence on system architecture and code quality

 - You’ll mentor engineers, contribute to our product & engineering culture, and help build the team (including participating in hiring, shaping our interview loops, etc.).

You would be a good fit in Mo if most of this sounds like you:

 - Applied background in software engineering and systems architecture

 - Experience with traditional ML, or LLMs, or ML dev ops is a big plus.

 - Product-minded: you want your solutions to be used, and impactful

 - Self-directed, pragmatic, driven, hard working

 - Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!)

 - Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching

 - Fluent in English (no need to speak French!)

 - Ex-founders are typically great fit in our team

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.




🤘 HOW WE DO IT ?

We benefit from Alan’s platform, infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise — but operate with the speed and focus of a startup. If you’re curious about Alan’s broader vision, our  https://www.notion.so/alaninsuranceShareholder Letters https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-2025-q3-letter-to-shareholders are worth a read.

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values https://alan.com/about/company-culture that guide our approach to work, such as:




HOW WE WORK: OUR LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

 - Mission is the Boss — We think long-term and are methodical optimists who take risks, seeking our mission's success above all else.

 - Distributed Ownership — Accountable enlightened despots: everyone owns their decisions and results.

 - Radical Transparency — All information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

 - Always Growing — Direct, positive, and caring feedback, combined with self-growth ownership.




🙌   PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

 - Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

 - Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

jobs.description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐ THE ENGINEERING TEAM ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of interactions.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

We are also the stewards of our members' most sensitive data, and building privacy in by design is core engineering work for us, not an afterthought.

Want to know more? Read this article https://medium.com/alan/a-new-iteration-of-our-engineering-career-path-at-alan-f46f7b229b2d on our Engineering career path.




🛠️ THE STACK

Python/Flask, Typescript, React, React Native on the coding side. AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, Terraform/Terramate, Datadog, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions on the platform side, all in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.




🤖 THE DATA FOUNDATIONS CREW - WITHIN THE TECH FOUNDATIONS AREA




🎯 MISSION

 - Tech Foundations - enables product crews and creates the environment to thrive, combining world-class infrastructure, intuitive developer experience, exquisite operational excellence, and built-in security to make shipping exceptional products effortless.

 - Data Foundations - is one of its crews. Its mission: be the enabling and platform team for data lifecycle and privacy engineering across Alan: retention, deletion, anonymization, and pseudonymization, by design. It builds and runs the GDPR Orchestrator (the platform's current embodiment) and equips each area to own its own data rules on top of it. The team also handles data shared with third parties and partners, with Legal and Security on requirements, including authority-facing work (e.g. CNIL).


🔭 SCOPE

 1. Own and evolve the privacy platform (build & run): its core engine, its safety mechanisms (preview/dry-run, audit trail), and its operational health (deploys, on-call, observability). You design the contract areas build on and keep it reliable as adoption grows.

 2. Build the paved road (enable, teach to fish): docs, templates, and self-serve tooling so any of our 15+ areas can plug into the platform and manage its own data rules and dependencies. You coach areas through pairing and syncs; you build the capability rather than doing the work for them.

 3. Coordinate across areas (the cross-area bridge): align legal, security, data, and the data-producing areas on requirements, surface cross-area data dependencies, and resolve design trade-offs between them. You own the coordination; each area stays accountable for its own data and rules.

 4. Push the foundations forward: drive open platform design questions to a conclusion and grow the platform's capabilities as Alan's data, products, and footprint expand.
    
    


👀 FOCUS FOR 2026

 - Own the platform: become the long-term owner of the GDPR Orchestrator and shape the roadmap for how Alan manages data lifecycle at scale.

 - Raise the bar on the platform: invest in its safety, observability, and developer experience so areas build on it with confidence.

 - Lay the paved road: ship the docs, templates, and tooling that let areas self-serve, then move ownership of data rules to the areas that produce the data.

 - Scale the surface: grow the platform's reach across data stores and third-party systems as Alan expands into new countries.
   
   


⭐ IS IT YOU WE'RE LOOKING FOR?




EXPERIENCE WE VALUE

 - Senior-level experience (typically 8+ years) in backend or platform software engineering, or equivalent, with deep production ownership (API and contract design, data modeling, running what you ship).

 - You've built and operated platforms, libraries, or services that other engineers depend on, and you care about the contract you expose to them.

 - You're comfortable operating across many teams and influencing without authoritarianism: getting legal, security, data, and product crews who don't report to you aligned on a plan, and driving it to completion.

 - You bring pragmatism under constraint: you ship sound, safe solutions and improve them over time, rather than waiting for perfect.

 - Strong plus: prior privacy, GDPR, or data-governance exposure, and experience working in an enabling or platform-team operating model.

 - Explicitly not required: deep legal expertise. Legal and security partner with this role; they don't get replaced by it.
   
   


MINDSET WE VALUE

 - You treat platform engineering as product work: engineers and members are your customers, and doing the right thing with their data should feel effortless.

 - You're hands-on: writing code is the bulk of the job (Python, TypeScript). You ship what you write to production yourself, then operate it: rollouts, alerting, on-call, incident response.

 - You design and communicate: you're as comfortable writing a framing doc, drawing a dependency map, and aligning several areas on a design decision as you are writing the code.

 - You're an enabler: you measure your impact by how fast areas run their own data rules without ever consulting you. The harder you've worked, the less they have to engage you.

 - You build reusable patterns: guardrails, libraries, and safe-by-default abstractions that keep data handling correct and safe by design at scale.

 - You're fluent in English (French is not required).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire above the E level range https://medium.com/alan/a-new-iteration-of-our-engineering-career-path-at-alan-f46f7b229b2d.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.




🌍 HOW WE WORK

 - Location: You must be legally eligible to work in France, Belgium, or Spain.

 - Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration.

 - Oversee KYC Ops referents' training and upskilling, including Belgium-specific AML requirements

 - Coordinate with the AMLO on annual priorities, documentation, monitoring tools, and regulatory reporting to the ACPR and equivalent supervisors

Compliance Roadmap & Stakeholder Coordination

⭐ YOUR MISSION

We are building Alan in Saudi Arabia, and you will be the person who makes us known, trusted, and chosen.

As Alan's first marketing hire in Saudi, you will sit at the intersection of strategy and execution, working hand-in-hand with the Saudi GM. You won't wait for a playbook to be handed to you, you'll help write it, then execute it yourself. You'll be the one who turns Alan's global assets into locally resonant stories, generates the first pipeline signals, and builds the brand that makes the best companies in Riyadh want to be Alan customers.




YOUR MISSIONS WILL INCLUDE:

Strategy & Execution (in one role)

 - Work directly with the Saudi GM to build annual, quarterly & monthly go-to-market plans and execute the experiments yourself. This is a hands-on role — you own both the thinking and the doing.

 - Prioritise ruthlessly: in a market where Alan is not yet known, you'll sequence brand and awareness ahead of a mature inbound machine, and adjust as signals come in.

Brand, Comms & Social (your primary mandate)

You'll own how Alan shows up in Saudi and make it culturally resonant — this is what will actually make Alan cut through.

 - Establish Alan as a top-of-mind, trusted brand in Saudi, adapting Alan's global brand initiatives into locally and culturally relevant campaigns (Arabic-native, attuned to local moments and employer expectations).

 - Own organic social end-to-end — define Alan Saudi's social voice and editorial pillars, and activate the right platforms for a B2B and employer-brand audience (LinkedIn as anchor, plus Instagram/TikTok/YouTube as they fit), consistent with global frameworks but locally led.

 - Lead PR and comms for Saudi milestones — coordinate media opportunities and press releases to position Alan's voice in local health and employee-benefits conversations.

 - Bring strong copywriting and storytelling instincts — every word you write should earn its place.

What success looks like: Alan is increasingly known and trusted among target buyers in Saudi. Branded organic traffic and brand awareness are growing, social is building a qualified local audience, and Alan is showing up credibly in the market's conversations.


Content & SEO/GEO

 - Build and maintain Alan's Saudi website presence, ensuring it reflects local messaging and SEO/GEO priorities.

 - Produce and prioritise content (blogs, videos, social posts, adapting global playbooks) that builds awareness and creates organic search presence.

 - Localise Alan's global SEO/GEO playbook and rigorously track impact.

Events into inbound growth

Build repeatable event formats and make sure their impact extends beyond the room. You will support events by:

 - Supporting event logistics, timelines, registration pages, and materials

 - Creating follow-up emails and digital touchpoints after events

 - Turning event themes and conversations into content

 - Helping Sales follow up with the right people

 - Using event activity to create retargeting audiences, campaign inputs, and reusable content

What success looks like: Events that are well supported operationally and consistently translated into digital, content, and inbound inputs that can be reused over time.




👀 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - You are a genuine swiss knife. You are equally comfortable writing a press release, building a landing page, and hosting a breakfast event for HR leaders. You don't wait for specialists:  your role spans across brand, growth, and product marketing. You spot and fill the gap yourself.

 - You go local first. You understand that global assets are a starting point, not a finish line. You naturally translate messages, visuals, and events into what resonates in the Saudi market.

 - You are data-driven, not opinion-driven. You define success metrics before you start. You know the difference between vanity metrics and the ones that actually move the pipeline.

 - You build to last. When you build something, you document it so it scales. You think in systems and playbooks, not one-offs.

 - You thrive in 0-to-1. The absence of a fully-built machine energises you rather than frustrates you. Ambiguity is something you resolve, not something you escalate.

 - You are a natural collaborator. You work closely with Sales, feed them what they need, and you're comfortable spending time in customer conversations to test your narratives and positiong live.

 


⭐️ REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE

Must-haves

 - 4–6 years of experience in growth or generalist marketing, ideally in a startup or scaleup environment

 - Demonstrated versatility across multiple mission areas (brand, content/SEO, events, product marketing)

 - Fluent in Arabic and English (written and spoken).

 - Strong copywriting and storytelling skills: can write compelling copy in both Arabic and English

 - Hands-on experience with paid platforms (Google Ads and/or LinkedIn Ads)

 - Comfort with data: can set up basic tracking, read dashboards, and iterate based on performance

 - Entrepreneurial mindset: a self-starter who doesn't need a 50-person team to make things happen

Nice to haves

 - Experience in B2B SaaS, healthtech, insurtech or HR tech

 - Familiarity with the Saudi or GCC business landscape and HR buyer profiles

 - Experience with SEO tools (Semrush, Ahrefs, Search Console)

 - Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms

 - Has worked as a first or early marketing hire before

Level target: C1–D on Alan's level grid 




⭐ WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary: we believe in paying well and trusting people to do great work

 - Meaningful equity: you are building this from scratch, and you should share in what you create

 - A world-class team to lean on: you won't be alone. You'll have the full support of Alan's international sales, product, and operations teams

 - Alan's health coverage (of course 😊)

 - The tools to do your best work: MacBook, the best software, and an environment built for focus

 - Real ownership and impact: you are not a cog in a machine. You are the machine.

 - Track record of shipping quality products - You're experienced working within cross-functional product and engineering teams to deliver exceptional user experiences

 - Design mentorship experience - You've coached and guided junior designers, helping them grow their skills and careers

 - Full-stack design expertise - You have proven skills across UX research, UI design, and visual design, with the ability to deliver production-ready assets that developers can implement seamlessly

 - Embrace of AI and other innovative tools - You're curious about and experienced with leveraging AI-powered design tools and emerging technologies

 - Strong English communication - You're fluent in English and can collaborate effectively with our international team (French is a plus but not required)

You will be Alan's flag-bearer in KSA: the person who shapes how we sell, who we sell to, and how we build relationships with companies that want to offer their employees a truly great health experience.

This is not a role for someone looking for a well-defined playbook to execute. It is a role for someone who wants to write the playbook — and who has the experience to do so.




⭐️ YOUR MISSION

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and outreach to discovery, demo, offer building, and closing.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.



As Founding Sales for KSA, you will also:

 - Build Alan's local presence with HR Directors, CFOs, and C-level decision-makers at companies who care about their employees' wellbeing

 - Act as the eyes and ears of the company in KSA — feeding market intelligence, prospect feedback, and local insights back to the product and strategy teams

 - Shape the sales function in KSA — setting the rituals, tools, and standards that future teammates will build on

 - Evangelize Alan's approach in the market, positioning Alan as a trusted and innovative health partner for Saudi employers

 - Contribute to Alan globally — leveraging and enriching the playbooks built in France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada



 ⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

You’ll be a great fit if you:

 - Are currently allowed to work legally for any employer in KSA, based in or willing to relocate to Riyadh

 - Have Saudi citizenship

 - Have 5+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in the tech or SaaS space (you are familiar with product demos, discovery frameworks, complex deal cycles)

 - Have demonstrated the ability to prospect, close, and build — not just manage existing accounts

 - Are highly autonomous — you thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and don't need a fully built machine to be effective

 - Have native or fluent Arabic

 - Have strong written and verbal communication skills in English

 - Are analytical, organized, and rigorous — you manage your pipeline with precision

 - Have empathy — you genuinely care about understanding and solving the problems of the companies and people you work with

 - Are not driven primarily by commissions — you are motivated by impact, ownership, and long-term value creation

jobs.description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐ BUILD THE AI-NATIVE COMPANY, FOR REAL

Alan has spent 10 years developing a distinctive way of working: radical transparency, written culture, distributed decision-making, no managers, no meetings by default. This wasn't just philosophy. It was a deliberate architectural choice, and it made Alan one of the most productive companies in European tech.

Now, agentic AI empowers us to make it much more personalized. The principles that made Alan productive become the foundation for a much more ambitious journey: a company where AI agents handle organizational complexity, surface the right context instantly, and let every person focus on the work that matters.

The Work Environment area builds that. Alaners are our users, and our internal platform is a Tier-1 product. The team is small and growing fast, and you'll lead its engineering.




🚀 WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

 - 🏠 Alan Home, the portal every Alaner opens first. The internal Operating System and the source of truth for who's who and who has access to what.

 - ⚙️ The rails the company runs on. Our automation platform, Identity & Access Management, Privileged Access Management, and user lifecycle automation across 25+ systems.

 - 🧱 Alan-native software instead of generic SaaS. Where a vendor forces Alan into someone else's way of working, we replace it, internalize and build our own. You'll hold the bar on which replacements earn their place, with a written case and a real ROI.

 - 🧑‍🚀 A growing team. You'll hire it, shape it, and decide what it works on. Talent density, onboarding, feedback, and the mix of skills the area needs are yours to own.

 - 🛡️ Technical direction and operational excellence. Architecture calls, quality standards, security practices, and incident response for systems that every single Alaner depends on. And you stay hands-on: at Alan, engineering leaders are expected to build.
   
   


⚡ WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

 - Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth, engineers become better while building better products

 - Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

 - Your users sit next to you. Every Alaner uses what your team ships, every day. The feedback loop between building and impact is very short, which allows you to iterate and move quickly.
   
   


🔍 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Leadership experience

 - 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

 - You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

 - Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

 - Experience with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools

 - Recent hands-on experience. You still review code, and you still write some.

What we value

 - Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

 - You develop people as much as you develop products.

 - Fluent in English (French is a plus but not required).

Mission alignment:

 - Healthcare technology and innovation excite you

 - You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning
   
   


🌍 HOW WE WORK

Location: you must be legally eligible to work in France, Belgium, or Spain.

Hybrid approach: amazing office spaces, sponsored co-working hubs, or full remote. We want you where you're most effective at leading and developing your team.

Growth mindset: every Alaner gets a dedicated coach from day one. As a leader, you'll have additional support for developing your leadership skills.




🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

jobs.title: Sales Graduate Program Recruitment Day (Paris) 💫
jobs.description:
PARTICIPE À NOTRE JOURNÉE EXCEPTIONNELLE DE RECRUTEMENT POUR REJOINDRE NOTRE SALES GRADUATE PROGRAM CHEZ ALAN !



Tu es diplômé(e) d'un Master avec maximum 2 ans d'expérience et tu souhaites débuter ta carrière dans la vente ? Le jeudi 8 Octobre 2026, Alan t’invite à une journée de recrutement exclusive dans nos bureaux parisiens.


Nous ouvrons seulement 24 places pour participer à cette journée, avec l’opportunité unique de décrocher ton CDI au sein de notre Sales Graduate Program. Saisis ta chance de lancer ta carrière en tant que Business Development Representative (BDR) dès Janvier 2027 (ou selon tes disponibilités), d’acquérir des bases solides en vente, et de tracer ta voie vers des rôles Sales seniors chez Alan en 18 à 24 mois !


Pourquoi participer ?

 - Vis une expérience unique & décroche ta place dans notre Sales Graduate Program : un véritable tremplin pour propulser ta carrière dans la vente.

 - Plonge dans l’univers d’Alan : découvre notre vision et notre ambition au contact direct de nos Alaners.

 - Bénéficie d’un process rapide & transparent : avec une réponse sous 48h à l’issue de la journée.

 - Plonge au cœur du métier de BDR chez Alan : découvre concrètement ce rôle à travers des mises en situation et des échanges privilégiés avec l’équipe.



Le processus de recrutement :

 - 📅 Date de l’événement : Jeudi 8 Octobre 2026

 - 📍 Lieu : Siège d’Alan : 117 Quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris

 - ⏰ Date limite de candidature : Jeudi 1 Octobre 2026

 - 📈 Les étapes :
   
   - Nous étudions toutes les candidatures reçues pour sélectionner les meilleurs profils.
   
   - Si ton profil est retenu, nous t’appellerons pour t’annoncer la nouvelle et échanger brièvement sur tes motivations.
   
   - Tu recevras un cas pratique à réaliser chez toi : des questions de motivation et un pitch vidéo à enregistrer.
   
   - Les candidat(e)s retenu(e)s seront invité(e)s à rejoindre notre journée exclusive au siège d’Alan, avec au programme une étude de cas et des entretiens.
   
   - À l’issue de cette journée, nous donnons notre réponse en 48h, et les profils sélectionnés rejoindront l’aventure Alan au sein de notre Sales Graduate Program à partir de Janvier 2027 !




⭐️ TOUT SAVOIR SUR NOTRE SALES GRADUATE PROGRAM

Le principe ? Sur une période de 18 à 24 mois, nous t’offrons l'opportunité d'évoluer au sein du rôle de Business Development Representative (BDR) en acquérant progressivement des compétences plus avancées dans la vente.

 - Phase 1 : Apprends les bases du métier de BDR : prospection, compréhension du marché, création d’opportunités, échanges avec des décideurs.

 - Phase 2 : Développe ton leadership : en tant que BDR, prends des responsabilités transverses telles que le recrutement, le coaching des nouveaux, l’animation de formations et la gestion de projets.

 - Phase 3 : Spécialise-toi : concentre-toi soit sur la prospection des grands comptes (plus complexes et stratégiques), soit sur les PME, en menant des rendez-vous de découverte et des démonstrations produit.

Cette progression au sein du rôle de BDR te permettra de développer des compétences commerciales complètes qui te prépareront à une future mobilité interne en tant qu'Account Executive ou Inbound Sales.



Envie d’en savoir plus sur le Sales Graduate Program ?

👉 Découvre les coulisses de la première promotion ici https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/les-coulisses-de-notre-graduate-program-el%C3%A9onore-adrian-c8lif/

👉 Découvre l'équipe en vidéo ici https://www.youtube.com/watch?index=12&list=PL643LyZcrKMBB6X2XXrif644EaLHygW47&v=t5KX_f3zBII 

👉 Découvre comment on a conçu le programme ici https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/comment-structur%C3%A9-la-r%C3%A9ussite-bdr-chez-alan-el%C3%A9onore-adrian-qypef/

👉 Lis le témoignage inspirant https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/pourquoi-la-prospection-est-un-art-strat%C3%A9gique-et-jadore-diane-teste-gtguf/ de Diane sur pourquoi la prospection est un art stratégique

👉 Explore notre approche unique de la vente https://blog.alan.eu/nos-commerciaux-ne-vendent-pas




💥 ES-TU NOTRE CANDIDAT IDÉAL ?

Chez Alan, notre devise est "nous recrutons des personnes, pas des rôles" : nous valorisons les compétences interpersonnelles plus que techniques. Nous croyons que ton potentiel est ce qui compte vraiment.


Tu seras un bon fit pour rejoindre l'équipe Sales d'Alan si :

 - Tu détiens un Master d'une école de commerce, avec jusqu'à deux ans d'expérience professionnelle ;

 - Tu montres un intérêt fort pour la vente, et détiens idéalement une première expérience dans ce domaine

 - Tu es enthousiaste, animé(e) par notre mission, et désireux(se) de partager notre ambition ;

 - Tu es team player, organisé(e), et capable de gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément ;

 - Tu es désireux(se) d'apprendre et de grandir dans de nouveaux rôles ;

 - Tu es basé(e) à (ou prêt(e) à déménager à) Paris ou Bordeaux

Prêt(e) à rejoindre notre Business Development Representative - Graduate Program ?

Pour cette opportunité, nous visons à recruter dans la fourchette de niveau A2-B0 https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.



🐼 QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?

La vision d'Alan est de faire de la prévention la nouvelle norme de soin pour tous. 

Notre mission est d'aider les gens à vivre en bonne santé jusqu'à 100 ans tout en aidant les employeurs à être fiers, transformant les avantages santé d'un centre de coûts en leur investissement le plus précieux.

Nous construisons un partenaire santé intégré qui unit harmonieusement assurance et prestations de soins intelligentes en un seul système.

En connectant tous les aspects du soin - privé, public et direct consommateur - nous créons une expérience santé centrée sur nos membres. Grâce à un engagement profond, nous donnons à chacun les moyens de surmonter les obstacles de santé du quotidien et de vivre plus sainement.




🚀 COMMENT ON S'Y PREND ?

Les personnes qui rejoignent Alan sont souvent surprises et ravies par notre méthode de travail innovante. Nous avons un ensemble de valeurs culturelles https://alan.com/en/about qui guident notre approche du travail :

La mission est notre priorité — Nous pensons à long terme et sommes des optimistes méthodiques qui prenons des risques, recherchant avant tout la réussite de notre mission.

Responsabilité partagée — Chacun est responsable de ses décisions et de ses résultats.

Transparence radicale — Toutes les informations sont accessibles et consignées par écrit, afin que chacun puisse prendre les meilleures décisions de manière asynchrone.

En constante évolution — Du feedback direct, positif et bienveillant, associé à une prise en charge de son propre développement personnel.




🙌 AVANTAGES & BÉNÉFICES https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity

Chez Alan, nous croyons qu'être en bonne santé est un besoin fondamental, et cela commence avec nos employés. C'est pourquoi les Alaners bénéficient d'un environnement stimulant et d'avantages garantissant qu'ils sont heureux, efficaces et ne passent que du temps de qualité avec leurs collègues.

Par conséquent, nous offrons :

 - Récompenses équitables. Des packages d'equity généreux complètent ton salaire de base.

 - Bureau flexible. Espace de bureau incroyable dans notre HQ à Paris ou hub de co-working sponsorisé à Bordeaux.

 - Tous les outils dont tu as besoin. Équipement haut de gamme : Macbook Pro, clavier, support laptop, écran, et casque anti-bruit.

 - Politique de vacances flexible et horaires de travail flexibles. Organise ton temps comme tu le souhaites.

 - Assurance santé complète - prise en charge à 100% pour toi et tes enfants, 90-100% pour les partenaires selon ton pays (contrats permanents uniquement).

 - Transport. Avantages de transport spécifiques au pays.

 - Opportunités d'apprentissage et de formation. Politique de formation très flexible, livres gratuits et budget pour assister et parler lors de conférences si l'opportunité se présente.

 - Croissance personnelle par le coaching : Chez Alan, le coaching n'est pas juste un avantage - c'est au cœur de qui nous sommes. Chaque Alaner est accompagné par un coach dédié dès le premier jour, qui aide à maximiser son impact, nourrir l'engagement, et naviguer les valeurs d'Alan pour développer son plein potentiel.

 - Congé parental. Congé parental étendu pour tous les nouveaux parents.
   
   


NOTE IMPORTANTE : NOUS RECRUTONS DES PERSONNES, PAS DES RÔLES.

Si tu es intéressé(e) par cette opportunité mais ne coches pas toutes les cases, nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Tout le monde devrait se sentir libre de postuler car cela ne peut qu'apporter apprentissages ou succès.

Si tu t'identifies comme une femme : Savais-tu que les recherches montrent que les femmes postulent souvent, uniquement, quand elles remplissent 100% des exigences ?

Rappelle-toi, c'est juste un guide, pas une checklist.

Nous serons ravis de recevoir ta candidature !



🔖 Consulte nos pages À propos d'Alan https://alan.com/en/about, Medium https://medium.com/alan et Carrières https://alan.com/en/careers, ainsi que notre blog https://alan.com/fr-fr/blog et page Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.fr/Pr%C3%A9sentation/Travailler-chez-Alan-EI_IE1696043.16,20.htm?countryRedirect=true pour plus d'infos.#LI-DNP

jobs.title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
jobs.description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⚡ THE INBOUND SALES 🇫🇷 ROLE

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method https://alan.com/fr-fr/blog/tout-alan/a/nos-commerciaux-ne-vendent-pas. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.



What does make this role exciting :

 - You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

 - The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

 - You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

 - You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

 - You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

 - We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!




⭐ YOU WILL BE A GREAT FIT FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU: 

 - Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

 - Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

 - Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

 - Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

 - Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

 - Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

 - Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

 - Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.




🙌   PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan/a/perks

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

 - Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

 - Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

 - Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

 - Transport. Generous transit benefit

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

 - Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

 - Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan https://alan.com/about and Career https://alan.com/careers pages, as well as our Medium https://medium.com/alan, blog https://blog.alan.com/ and Glassdoor page https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm for more info.
