⭐️ THE MISSION OF THE UNION RELATIONS LEAD

Unions and social partners play a central and legitimate role in how social protection is designed, negotiated and implemented in France. We're looking for a Union Relations Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with unions, their federations, and the broader paritariste ecosystem, making Alan a trusted, substantive and well-known interlocutor of French social partners, and supporting our Enterprise & Public Sector teams across large private employers and public institutions.





 ⭐ WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE GENUINELY UNIQUE

 - You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health tech companies builds its relationships with the French social partner ecosystem (from confederations to sector federations to paritariste institutions).

 - You'll operate at the highest levels of the paritariste ecosystem: confederal leadership, sector federations, IP boards, organisations patronales.

 - You'll shape the strategy, not just execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability (the playbook is yours to define)

 - You'll work directly with Founders, Public Affair as well as Public Sector and Enterprise leadership.

 - Real ownership from day one, in one of the fastest-growing tech unicorns in Europe.




⭐️ YOUR ROLE

Relationships & Presence

 - Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the organizations that represent employees and members across the sectors that matter to Alan (unions, federations, and the structures that convene them).

 - Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design the engagement strategy at confederal, federal and branch level.

 - Represent Alan in federations, working groups, congrès and paritariste institutions where our sector’s future is discussed.

 - Be the credible consistent Alan voice social partners recognise



Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Public Sector work

 - Be a partner to our teams serving large private employers and public sector clients, briefing them on the social partners context and how Alan’s offer speaks to their priorities

 - Introduce the right contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, turning Alan’s ecosystem relationships into concrete commercial leverage.

 - Share Alan’s content with social partners to help them assess Alan on its merits and form their own view.



Sector Engagement & Anticipation

 - Follow the dialogue at branch level and across the paritariste ecosystem and turn that understanding into internal clarity.

 - Represent Alan in the federations and working groups where our sector's future is discussed, contributing a constructive and recognizable voice.

 - Be a sharp, early internal voice on where social dialogue is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy.



Build & Scale

 - Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on social partner positions, branch agreements, and paritariste institutions shared with Enterprise and Public Sector deal teams to increase win rates.

 - Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our social partner engagement and documentation.

 - Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Public Sector team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

 - Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how social partners and competitors position themselves in our key markets.



 ⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

You’ll be a great fit for the Union Relations Lead role at Alan if you:

 - Have at least 8 years of total experience in social partner relations: in a union organization, a branch federation, a paritariste institution, or in an external affairs role at a mutelle, IP or insurer

 - Have legitimate credibility at federation level: ability to engage federation leadership as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive engagement at federation level on employer side.

 - Have deep knowledge of the paritariste ecosystem: branch agreements, confederal mandates, protection sociale reforms, and how institutions at each level function

 - Have proven ability to build trust with social partners from the employer/state side

 - Have outstanding stakeholder management: calm, long-game, trustworthy, discreet, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself.

 - Have ability to translate Alan’s product and strategy into compelling narratives for social partner audiences

 - Demonstrable impact from prior social-partner work on an organization’s commercial and strategic outcomes

 - Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

 - Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight.

 - Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris.



Nice to have:

 - A confederal or federal elected / permanent past.

 - Experience inside a paritariste institution

 - Experience inside a sector federation on its social dialogue agenda.

 - Legal background in droit social and comfort reading accords collectifs quickly.

 - International exposure to the European social dialogue ecosystem.

 - Prior experience with RFPs or tenders involving union-negotiated or paritariste schemes.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Alan operates at the intersection of health insurance, prevention, and regulated data. The person in this role owns the security governance and risk posture of a company that handles sensitive health data for 1M+ members, operates under DORA and HDS certification requirements, and is regulated by the ACPR. They work in close partnership with Legal, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function. It's a highly collaborative role.




🛡️ YOUR MISSION: GOVERNANCE, RISK & COMPLIANCE

Own and operate the ISO 27001 ISMS. You are the accountable owner of the Information Security Management System: scope definition, Statement of Applicability, internal audit programme, and management review. You've led at least one full certification or recertification cycle and know what breaks down in the months between audits.

Be the security expert on regulatory and privacy matters. Legal leads on DORA, HDS, RGPD, PGSSI-S, and regulatory relationships. Your role is to bring the technical and operational security substance: translating regulatory requirements into controls, flagging implementation gaps, and making sure the security programme is solid when the regulatory team negotiates with the ACPR or ANS.

Run risk as an ongoing programme, in partnership with the broader risk function. You lead security risk cartography using EBIOS RM and ensure it feeds into, and is informed by, the company-wide risk framework. You facilitate risk workshops, produce treatment plans, and bring the security lens to forums where non-security risks are also on the table. You know when a security risk is really a business risk.

Own the controls framework, but distribute ownership of controls themselves. You define the framework, set the standards, and track coverage, but the controls live with the teams who build and run the things they protect. You work closely with Infrastructure, Platform, and Engineering to ensure foundational building blocks (identity, network, secrets management, logging) are designed with security requirements built in from the start. You work alongside those teams as a partner.

Run audit cycles with rigour, in close partnership with Internal Audit. You manage the security audit programme and coordinate with certification bodies. You work with Internal Audit to align scopes, avoid duplication, and present a coherent picture of control effectiveness to the board. You've sat in joint audit planning sessions and know how to make that relationship work well.

Manage third-party risk. You run vendor security assessments and define contractual security requirements (security annexes, DPAs). You partner with our Risk team, which oversees third-party risk, and own the security dimension.

Bring the health sector context. You understand the ANS framework, CERT Santé requirements, and what it means to handle sensitive health data in day-to-day operations. You're a useful partner to Legal when the question is "what does this regulation actually require us to do technically?"

Own incident governance and support DORA reporting. You classify and escalate ICT incidents internally, own BCP and DRP governance, and provide the security substance for DORA incident reports.




🚀 WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

Compliance Framework: ISO 27001, DORA, HDS, NIS2. Multiple regulators, multiple countries, one coherent governance backbone. Build the system that lets Alan scale from 1M to many millions of members without rebuilding compliance every time.

Automated Audit & Evidence Engine: Replace manual evidence collection with scripted pipelines plugged directly into engineering systems. Turn audit cycles into a continuous capability instead of a quarterly rush.

Risk Cartography: Risk treated as an operational signal that feeds directly into business and engineering decisions, with EBIOS RM at the core.

You'll work closely with Legal, DPO, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function, and partner day-to-day with Infrastructure, Platform, Engineering, Product, and Operations. You're the bridge between regulatory complexity and operational simplicity.




⚡ WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

Direct Impact: You own the trust foundation that lets Alan handle health data for 1M+ members and operate in highly regulated markets. Your work is the precondition for everything else Alan does.

Complex Problems: 4 regulators across 4 countries, sensitive health data, and a regulatory landscape that keeps shifting (DORA, NIS2, AI Act), all to be modeled into a single, coherent control system.

Ownership & Growth: Board and executive exposure, real influence on company-wide risk decisions, and the autonomy to shape Alan's security culture across 800+ people.




🤝 WHAT YOU WILL ALSO DO: TECHNICAL ENABLEMENT

Automate compliance work wherever possible. You script evidence collection, automate control testing, and connect GRC tooling to engineering pipelines. You've used Python or similar to reduce the manual work of an audit cycle, and you actively look for the next process to streamline.

Configure and own GRC tooling. You can administer platforms like CISO Assistant, ServiceNow GRC, or Archer, designing workflows, building dashboards, and making them genuinely useful for the teams that feed them data.

Speak cloud governance fluently. You understand shared responsibility in HDS-qualified environments, know what CSPM tools surface and what they miss, and can reason about policy-as-code (OPA, SCP) without needing an engineer to translate.

Read architecture well enough to challenge it. You can review a proposed architecture, identify control gaps in identity, network segmentation, encryption, or logging, and push back credibly with engineers even though you're not one.

Interpret vulnerability data and drive prioritisation. You read scan outputs, work with engineering teams to prioritise remediation by business impact over CVSS score alone, and track resolution KPIs over time.




⭐️ QUALIFICATIONS, MINDSET AND SOFT SKILLS

You translate risk into business language. You can brief a board or an audit committee and leave them genuinely informed. You know the difference between a finding that requires an emergency board call and one that belongs in a quarterly report.

You influence without authority. You align Legal, DPO, Risk, Engineering, Product, and Operations on security requirements without creating blockers or adversarial dynamics. People come to you early because you make their work easier.

You manage programmes with audit-grade rigor. You run structured, traceable roadmaps. You know where every commitment is, who owns it, and when it's due. You escalate proactively and don't let dependencies surprise you.

You build a genuine security culture. Your awareness programmes land because they're relevant to the people who take them. You foster proportionate risk ownership across the company, so teams make better day-to-day decisions.

You think in principles when frameworks shift. DORA is live. NIS2 transposition pace varies. The AI Act is arriving. When the regulatory landscape moves, you reason from first principles and adapt without waiting to be told what to do.




🌍 HOW WE WORK

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France, Belgium or Spain.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration




🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

Want to know more? Read this article https://blog.alan.com/tech-et-produit/engineering-organisation-at-alan if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article https://medium.com/alan/engineering-career-path-at-alan-e5de5c2e740c on our Engineering career path.

Please note that for this internship, you need to be based in Paris, France, and currently enrolled in your last year of a Master's degree in a university.


You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

 - You are looking for your 6-month end-of-studies internship and want to start in H1 2027

 - You have prior internship or side-projects coding experience, and have already deployed frontend and backend code to production for real users

 - You are willing to work in Python/JavaScript (but you don't need to have experience with those 2 languages!)

 - You are passionate about building products

 - You are self-starting and humble

 - You are collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork and learning

 - Fluent in English (no need to speak French!)

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

jobs.title: Ops Builder - Sénégal / Ivory Coast
jobs.description:
⭐️ LA SANTÉ N'ATTEND PAS.


Que les symptômes s’aggravent. Qu'il faille 6 mois avant d’obtenir un rendez-vous. Qu'on dépende d’un système de santé englué dans le papier et les processus manuels. Et pourtant, c’est ainsi que fonctionne aujourd’hui la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest. Vous attendez, jusqu’à ne plus pouvoir attendre.

Nous existons pour mettre fin à cette attente.

Née en 2022 au Sénégal, Tanel est la première assurance santé numérique d’Afrique de l’Ouest francophone. Elle opère au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire. Nous transformons un marché dominé par les processus papier et des acteurs historiques fragmentés. Avec plus de 30 000 membres, un réseau de plus de 1 200 établissements de santé et de plus de 400 pharmacies, ainsi qu’un chiffre d'affaires multiplié par 7 en 2025, nous avons démontré une véritable adéquation entre notre produit et les besoins du marché, dans des pays qui avaient besoin d’une révolution.

En 2026, Alan, le leader européen de l’assurance santé axée sur la prévention, avec plus de 950 M€ de CA et + 1 M de membres en France, en Belgique, en Espagne et au Canada, a acquis Tanel afin d’accélérer son expansion sur le continent africain. Ensemble, nous construisons l’assurance santé de référence en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, avec l’ambition d’atteindre 200 M$ de CA d’ici 2030.


NOUS RÉUNISSONS LE MEILLEUR DES DEUX MONDES : L’EXPERTISE DE TERRAIN DE TANEL, SES RELATIONS LOCALES ET LA CONFIANCE QU’ELLE A SU BÂTIR, AINSI QUE LA PLATEFORME TECHNOLOGIQUE DE POINTE D’ALAN, SON EXPERTISE ACTUARIELLE ET SON EXPÉRIENCE DU DÉPLOIEMENT DANS PLUSIEURS PAYS.

🤹 LES OPÉRATIONS CHEZ ALAN

Les opérations sont une fonction stratégique. Nous définissons la vision, construisons les systèmes et pilotons les résultats qui rendent possible l’assurance santé digitale et le parcours de santé à grande échelle, sur des marchés où tout reste à inventer.

L’équipe Opérations développe nos capacités opérationnelles et fait évoluer efficacement notre plateforme afin d’accompagner la croissance, d’optimiser les coûts et les ressources, et de diversifier nos produits. Nous avançons vite, avec un fort niveau de responsabilité, et sommes fiers de nous attaquer à des problèmes complexes.

Nous recherchons des personnes prêtes à réinventer, et pas simplement améliorer, l’assurance et la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, afin de transformer l’expérience de nos membres et de nos clients entreprises.



⭐️ VOTRE MISSION ⭐️

La description du poste est simple : définir la vision, prendre les décisions difficiles, délivrer et assumer les résultats.

En tant qu’Operations Builder, vous construirez et développerez l’infrastructure opérationnelle qui nous permettra de passer de 30 000 à plusieurs centaines de milliers de membres en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone. Vous prendrez en charge des problématiques critiques et ambiguës, avec un impact direct et visible sur nos membres au quotidien.


EXEMPLES DE SUJETS À PRENDRE EN CHARGE

 - Construire un moteur de gestion des sinistres à grande échelle : automatiser l’analyse des dossiers, les remboursements et les recouvrements, développer une capacité de détection de la fraude et piloter l’ensemble du parcours, du rapprochement avec les prestataires à la satisfaction des membres.

 - Industrialiser la gestion du réseau de prestataires : structurer le pilotage de plus de 1 200 établissements et 400 pharmacies, améliorer la fiabilité des paiements, suivre la qualité et développer le réseau dans de nouveaux territoires.

 - Déployer les opérations dans de nouveaux pays : construire un modèle opérationnel à partir de zéro, intégrer les exigences réglementaires locales, adapter le produit et mettre en place les partenariats nécessaires.

 - Mettre en place le suivi de l’excellence opérationnelle : suivre les volumes, l’efficacité, les SLA et la performance financière, identifier les risques et déployer des améliorations continues grâce à l’IA et à l’automatisation.

 - Construire et développer l’équipe Operations : contribuer au recrutement, accompagner les profils plus juniors et définir les standards d’excellence opérationnelle chez Alan.


⭐️ PROFIL ET COMPÉTENCES ⭐️

 - 3 à 5 ans d’expérience dans une scale-up ou un environnement entrepreneurial exigeant.

 - Maîtrise parfaite du français et un niveau d’anglais avancé.

 - Capacité à définir une vision et à la traduire en plan d’action concret, en intégrant les dimensions business, expérience client, réglementaire et financière.

 - Capacité à construire et optimiser des processus garantissant qualité, performance et évolutivité.

 - Goût pour la création de produits et services à partir de zéro, avec une approche centrée utilisateur et fondée sur les données.

 - Aisance dans les environnements très ambigus, sans mode opératoire préétabli.

 - Esprit pratique, rigueur et organisation, avec une capacité à entrer dans le détail.

 - Capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés : équipes locales, clients entreprises, professionnels de santé, régulateurs et siège Alan.


CE SERAIT UN PLUS

 - Expérience en assurance santé, mutuelle, structure IPM ou opérations de santé en Afrique de l’Ouest ou dans un autre marché émergent.

 - Connaissance de la zone réglementaire CIMA ou des marchés de l’assurance au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire.

 - Maîtrise de SQL pour analyser les données de manière autonome.

 - Maîtrise de l’IA et de l’automatisation.


⭐️ CE QUE NOUS ATTENDONS AU COURS DES 12 PREMIERS MOIS ⭐️

 - Prendre en charge un domaine opérationnel clé : sinistres, facturation, affiliation ou réseau de prestataires, et le rendre significativement plus efficace et évolutif.

 - Construire un cadre de suivi de la performance et identifier les principales pistes d’amélioration.

 - Contribuer au lancement des opérations d’Alan dans au moins un nouveau pays, en mettant en place les partenariats locaux et en adaptant notre modèle.

 - Participer au développement de l’équipe Operations, notamment au recrutement et à l’intégration de nouveaux membres.

 - Porter la perspective Operations dans la roadmap produit et la stratégie de l’entreprise.


🎁 AVANTAGES

 - Type de contrat : CDI

 - Sur site, dans nos bureaux de Dakar ou Abidjan, en collaboration étroite avec une équipe locale passionnée.

 - Tous les outils nécessaires pour donner le meilleur de vous-même.

 - Une assurance santé complète via Alan pour vous et votre famille.

 - Des opportunités d'apprentissage et de formation : une politique RH flexible, des budgets pour les livres et les conférences.




🎯 NOTE IMPORTANTE : NOUS RECRUTONS DES PERSONNES, PAS DES RÔLES

Si cette opportunité vous intéresse mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions ravis d'échanger avec vous. Tout le monde devrait se sentir libre de postuler !

Rappelez-vous, ceci est un guide, pas une liste exhaustive. Nous serons ravis de recevoir votre candidature.



🔖 Consultez nos pages À propos d’Alan https://alan.com/about et Carrières https://alan.com/careers, ainsi que notre page Medium https://medium.com/alan, notre blog https://blog.alan.com/ et notre page Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm pour en savoir plus.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.




⭐️ OPERATIONS AT ALAN

The Operations Community’s core responsibilities is to deliver at scale our insurance and health services : we build our platform and operational capabilities and run our processes to guarantee delight and efficiency.

As we anchor our Insurance position, diversify our offering with health and well-being related services in 4 different countries (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada), our operations are increasingly complex and our challenges ahead have never been as exciting!

Being an Ops at Alan means joining a team of 50+ talented, committed and passionate Ops across our countries, with a lot of interactions with Engineering, Product, Care and many other teams at Alan.

We have a mix of Builder profiles, focused on (re)designing and implementing our processes and Operations Coordinators who deliver those on a daily basis while improving them.

We want team members to deliver excellence to our companies and members and be ready to disrupt (and not only upgrade) the way we traditionally think about insurance or healthcare services.



Want to learn more about Ops at Alan? Read how we work and hire https://app.notion.com/p/alaninsurance/Product-Ops-builders-and-coordinators-Alan-your-hiring-process-3021426e8be7815cb164d629cfe3b455 and watch our team in action https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL643LyZcrKMDaW7cW0_GytXy5VkaqTOU6

 


🌍 FOR THIS ROLE, YOU NEED TO BE BASED IN FRANCE, BELGIUM OR SPAIN 🌍



The Operations Coordinator works on a specific subset of services we deliver (eg. claim reimbursement, fraud, clinic to name a few) .

Their core responsibilities (+- 70/80% of the time) are to:

 - Run our Insurance or Health services processes - that's why we call them Ops Runners internally 😉

 - Ensure the day-to-day follow up and monitoring of our operations

 - Flag risks and opportunities

In details, your missions are:

 - Operating our processes: performing tasks like invoicing or claims treatment, growing and managing our network of providers, supporting internal teams (live and through documentation)

 - Contributing to the definition & owning the best monitoring scheme to track volumes/efficiency/SLAs, and identify risks and areas of improvement, internally or with our service providers

 - Supervising partnerships (e.g. teleconsultation, claim operators), participating in the negotiation rounds, daily communication to ensure business continuity

 - Performing controls on our daily operations to make sure the correct decisions were made and to identify training needs (internally as well as externally)

 - Escalating feedback, helping to prioritise and supporting initiatives to make our processes and services more delightful and efficient

Next to running and monitoring our operations, you implement continuous improvements to our processes (+-20/30% of the time). This can be in a variety of ways, e.g. working with product teams to automate certain processes, enhancing our external communication, auditing our processes, automating some process steps using automation tools, …




⭐️ OUR RUN ORGANISATION ⭐️

Our Operations Coordinators or Ops Runners are organized in pools (3-7 runners) who are collectively responsible for running their scope. Examples of topics are:

Alan therapy: members can book a therapy session with psychologists. You maintain smooth relationships with our psychologists, ensure therapy demand  matches the supply and contribute to several steps of their lifecycle at Alan (hiring, onboarding, invoicing, supporting booking management etc).

Claims: We provide a best-in-class claims experience, including our own optic care service. You treat claims and assist in decisions regarding our coverage. Additionally, you monitor the performance of external service providers to meet SLAs & perform quality controls. You ensure glasses get delivered on time, member satisfaction is high, our frame collection is attractive, collaboration with opticians is smooth and efficient, ….

Fraud: We run checks on claims submitted by our members, and build new ways of preventing fraud attempts. You investigate suspicious claims, prevent fraudulent payments or recover when we paid fraudulent claims.

Set up:  We provide best-in-class experience to our Customers : a smooth on/offboarding of their employees and a seamless invoicing or billing. To do so, we continuously control & improve the quality of our processes : ensuring we have consistent information for invoicing, unlocking employee invite/removals in case of issue and supporting admin in case of payment issue or bankruptcy.

Note: We look for profiles able to embrace any challenge and jump in any pool ! Depending on Alan needs (and personal interests), an Operations Coordinator will join in a pool and  can change and explore new scopes after some time. Do not hesitate to ask more concrete examples to the Operations Team Members you’ll meet during the process so they can share about their own scope.




⭐️ EXPERIENCE ⭐️

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

Since the scope of our Ops Runner role is extremely varied, we are open to candidates from different backgrounds : you could be a good fit for the Operations team at Alan if, for example, you:

 - Operated processes and services especially for companies during the scale up stage or in industrial/logistic industries

 - Worked in Support functions (Customer Support, People Operations etc)

 - Had a Customer facing Commercial experience, e.g. account manager or Customer Success Communications, such as Social Media, Internal/ External Communications

 - Handled event coordination




⭐️ SKILLS ⭐️

 - Passionate about delivering & optimizing top notch operations: not scared to get your hands dirty to get into technical processes, making them clear and delightful for our operators and members

 - A keen problem-solver and challenger with a dig deep mindset: what drives you is member and customer satisfaction !

 - Analytics skills, to be able to dive into our data

 - Highly organised with exceptional follow-up skills, with strong attention to details

 - Strong and structured in written and verbal communication in English as well as in French or Dutch 

 - Able to work and learn independently in a fast-paced environment

 - Adaptable: you show flexibility and a strong ability to adapt to variable situations

 - It’s even better if you have experience in the insurance or the healthcare industry




🙌  PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan/a/perks

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

 - Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

 - Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

 - Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

 - Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

 - Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

 - Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.




IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan https://alan.com/about and Career https://alan.com/careers pages, as well as our Medium https://medium.com/alan, blog https://blog.alan.com/ and Glassdoor page https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm for more info.



Please note that we don't sponsor Visas for the operations coordinator role.

You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy.

You will interact with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Meet Hakim in this article https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/l%C3%A9quipe-de-ventes-industrie-dalan-%C3%A0-la-rencontre-dhakim-hakim-essabar-jbrwf/?trackingId=972lxAWxToe2FJjh4mpF6Q%3D%3D to learn more about makes the Metallurgy segment so interesting for an Account Executive.



Why is our Vertical approach interesting?

 - Market potential: Vast and dynamic markets with significant structural challenges, offering fertile ground for a modern, tech-driven solution like Alan.

 - Team readiness: We've honed our go-to-market strategy over the years, and it's paying off with increasing inbound leads and active field marketing driving strong pipeline momentum.

 - Passionate teams: Our dedicated teams brings deep sector expertise and genuine passion for the clients we serve; every day in the field sharpens our edge and fuels our conviction.

 - Growth opportunity: The addressable market is enormous, offering virtually unlimited opportunities for growth.



What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. The average sales cycle is 4-6 months, dealing with companies ranging from 30 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method https://alan.com/fr-fr/blog/tout-alan/a/nos-commerciaux-ne-vendent-pas. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.



Meet Fanny Cibot https://www.linkedin.com/in/fanny-c-81b89b82/ who is Account Executive within the Business Services & Media Crew.



 ⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

You’ll be a great fit for the Metallurgy Team at Alan if you:

 - Have at least 4 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

 - Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

 - Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

 - Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

 - Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

 - Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

 - Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

 - Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

 - Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/sept-ans-chez-alan-pourquoi-je-nai-jamais-%25C3%25A9t%25C3%25A9-aussi-lucie-leflour-gwpce/ from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

 - Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

 - Transport. Generous transit benefit

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

 - Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

jobs.description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐ BUILD THE AI-NATIVE COMPANY, FOR REAL

Alan has spent 10 years developing a distinctive way of working: radical transparency, written culture, distributed decision-making, no managers, no meetings by default. This wasn't just philosophy. It was a deliberate architectural choice, and it made Alan one of the most productive companies in European tech.

Now, agentic AI empowers us to make it much more personalized. The principles that made Alan productive become the foundation for a much more ambitious journey: a company where AI agents handle organizational complexity, surface the right context instantly, and let every person focus on the work that matters.

As a Software Engineer on this team, you will:

 - Build the AI-powered internal platform that every Alaner uses daily to navigate the company, find context, and take action.

 - Design and ship intelligent agents that automate real organizational workflows: onboarding, knowledge retrieval, performance alignment, decision support.

 - Push LLMs into production for structured reasoning, agentic task execution, and deep integration with internal tools.

 - Define the primitives and abstractions of AI-native work, the patterns that scale across every team and every country Alan operates in.

 - Replace generic tools (HRIS, performance reviews, IAM) with opinionated, Alan-native software that compounds with our culture.

 - Build and scale our Identity & Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and user lifecycle across 25+ systems.

 - Collaborate with product, design, security and leadership to turn Alan's cultural principles into software that amplifies them.


WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

 - Alan's written, transparent, async culture generates an extraordinary volume of structured organizational knowledge. Most companies can't feed AI agents with high-quality internal data. Alan already can.

 - The team is building a full AI-native operational layer from scratch, not adding copilots to legacy tools.

 - Every Alaner uses what you ship, every day. The feedback loop between building and impact is immediate.

 - The work sits at the frontier of applied AI: agents, retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool use, human-in-the-loop design.

 - The ambition goes beyond Alan. The patterns you build here could define how high-performance companies operate in the AI era.


🛠 YOUR PLAYGROUND

 - Stack: Python/Flask, React, PostgreSQL, plus deep integration with LLM APIs and internal AI infrastructure.

 - What you'll do: design and ship AI-native tools that power how Alan works.  automated workflows, organizational navigation, agentic assistants.

 - Impact: your work shapes the daily experience of every Alaner and builds the playbook for the AI-native company.


👥 WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Software engineers with +5 years of experience, ideally with backend or full-stack experience.

 - Genuinely excited about AI and eager to explore what LLMs, agents, and retrieval systems can do inside a real product.

 - Comfortable building in fast-moving territory where the right abstractions don't exist yet.

 - Well-versed in OOP languages (Python, Java, C#) and modern web technologies.

 - Fluent in English (French is a plus but not required).

 - Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.


🙌 PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Fair rewards & equity packages.

 - Flexible office & remote options.

 - Top-tier equipment: MacBook Pro, monitor, noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation & hours.

 - Comprehensive healthcare for you, children, and partners.

 - Transport support and coaching for personal growth.

 - Training budget for conferences, courses, books.

 - Extended parental leave for all parents.


🔄 RECRUITMENT NOTE

🌟 We hire people, not roles. Don't worry if you don't check every box. High potential and curiosity matter most. We may even suggest another team if we see a better fit.

🔖 Learn more About Alan https://alan.com/about and on our Career pages https://alan.com/careers, Medium https://medium.com/alan, blog https://blog.alan.com/ and Glassdoor page https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE2297653.htm.

#LI-DNP

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.




THE LEGAL TEAM AT ALAN

You will join Alan's Corporate Unit, where teammates from diverse backgrounds combine their skills to overcome complex challenges and shape Alan's future growth. As a senior insurance legal expert, you will raise the bar for how Alan thinks about regulatory risk, setting standards and building others' legal instincts. You will collaborate closely with Alan's insurance legal counsels, and with our Business, Product, and Care teams. At Alan, roles evolve: you will have real opportunities to expand your scope across new verticals, markets, and regulated product bets.




YOUR MISSIONS

Regulatory strategy and compliance

 - Define Alan's angle on key regulatory requirements, turning complex constraints into business advantages with full autonomy and a sharp awareness of the competitive landscape.

 - Own Alan's insurance compliance posture: translate regulatory obligations into operational tools and processes, lead responses to inspections, and report on compliance risks to Alan's board and committees.

 - Develop strategies to influence regulatory evolutions, maintaining productive relationships with insurance regulators in close collaboration with public affairs teammates.

Business and commercial impact

 - Act as Alan's legal voice in strategic business conversations: engage directly with key prospects and clients, own the legal response to major RFPs, and lead complex negotiations.

 - Define offer strategies for large accounts, leveraging your regulatory expertise and sharp negotiation skills to unlock deals.

Product excellence and member protection

 - Identify the best ways to meet regulatory requirements within our products while improving the member experience (pricing, options design, UX, complaints management).

 - Protect Alan's competitive positioning on key regulatory topics.

International scope and legal autonomy

 - Oversee insurance compliance across Alan's markets, building foundational frameworks and distributed ownership structures to ensure robust compliance globally.

 - Lead the legal and regulatory dimensions of new international expansion (regulatory licensing, compliance plan design, strategic partnership negotiations, product building).

 - Build internal legal frameworks, templates, and decision-making guidelines that reduce reliance on external counsel. Define and implement an automation roadmap within your scope.
   
   


PROFILE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Experience

 - At least 10 years of insurance law and/or social protection law experience at a top insurance law firm or an international insurance company.

 - Fluency in French and professional English (written and spoken).

 - In-depth commercial experience, including negotiating or litigating complex health and disability insurance deals.

 - Broad familiarity with insurance regulatory frameworks: ACPR guidelines, insurance distribution rules, and applicable health and disability insurance regulations.

 - Bonus: experience on international markets and drafting in English; experience at a regulatory authority.
   
   

Qualities we are looking for to join our team

 - Strategic autonomy: You operate independently, set risk appetite, and make judgment calls on legal exposure with clarity and foresight.

 - Business mindset: You quickly identify what creates real value, and you are comfortable representing Alan's strong positions with key clients and regulators.

 - Rigor and pragmatism: Attention to detail and a drive for excellence, combined with a simplification instinct.

 - Appetite to grow others: You help teammates build stronger legal instincts and enable the broader organization to make fast, informed decisions.

 - Innovative problem-solving: Challenger mindset, willingness to define new practices and take considered risks.

 - Intellectual curiosity: Eagerness to become an expert in unfamiliar areas.

 - Bonus: Interest in leveraging technology and AI to streamline legal operations.
   
   

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the E-F level ranges https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.




🌍 HOW WE WORK

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

 


🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.




🚀 THE CHALLENGE

 - Alan is a leading European health insurer with over 1 million members across 4 countries (France, Belgium, Spain, Canada). At its core, Alan is a tech company that believes exceptional member experience is a competitive advantage:  fast, empathetic, and reliable service at scale. As of Q1 2026, 40% of conversations are handled automatically.

 - At the intersection of Care, Legal, Security, and Data Protection sits a set of topics that are as operationally complex as they are strategically critical: data breaches, GDPR rights requests, security incidents, legal complaints, regulatory reporting.

 - We are looking for a Care Legal & Security Specialist to own these topics end-to-end: handling complex cases in close collaboration with Alan's Legal and DPO teams, building the processes and training that allow our ~300 Care agents to manage them with confidence, and identifying where AI and automation can reduce manual load. As Alan accelerates across four countries, what you build in France gets replicated in Spain, Belgium, and Canada: your work doesn't stay local.

 - This is not a pure legal role, and it is not a pure ops role. You handle regulatory cases, improve the processes that prevent them from recurring, and scale what works across countries. You will be embedded within our Operational Excellence team, working in close collaboration with Care Ops and the Corporate Unit.
   
   
   
   
   👨‍🚀 MISSIONS
   
   
   
   1/ Operational run

 - Handle complex security incidents, GDPR cases, and legal complaints escalated from Care agents, including CNIL notifications (drafted in close collaboration with Legal and DPO, within the 72-hour regulatory deadline), account takeover situations, Level 2 and Level 3 complaints, and incoming legal mail

 - Manage interactions with external stakeholders (CNIL, Insurance Ombudsman, Signal Conso) with precision and within regulatory deadlines

 - Own KPI monitoring and reporting for legal and security matters; organize yearly complaints reporting for Alan's Board; identify trends and escalate systemic issues to Product teams early
   
   
   
   2/ Scalability: process, tools, and training

 - Design and continuously improve workflows, escalation paths, macros, and help center content so Care agents can handle legal and security cases autonomously at L1 and L2

 - Identify simplification and automation opportunities across legal and security operations, then collaborate with Care Ops and Product crews to deploy them, rather than solving each case manually

 - Build and maintain training materials (case studies, Q&As, simulations), so Care Experts develop real judgment, not just process familiarity

 - Ensure regulatory training completion across the team
   
   
   
   3/ Globalization

 - Translate processes, frameworks, and training materials built for France into resources that Care and Legal/Compliance teams in other countries can adopt

 - Coordinate actively with counterparts in other countries to share learnings, align on best practices, and anticipate regulatory divergences

 - Build shared resources so that when a new country goes live, the Care Legal & Security function isn't starting from scratch
   
   
   
   4/ Mentorship and cross-collaboration

 - Support Care Experts participating in the Legal & Security taskforce: build their judgment on complex and ambiguous cases, be the primary escalation reference for Care agents facing difficult legal or security situations

 - Collaborate with the Corporate Unit Lead and Care Ops to shape the Care roadmap on legal and security topics; translate regulatory constraints into executable processes and surface operational insights that should inform policy or product decisions
   
   
   
   
   ⭐ YOU'LL EXCEL IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Deliver reliably on high-stakes, deadline-driven cases with a real member-centric mindset

 - Have at least 1-2 years of experience in one of the following: GDPR / privacy operations, legal complaints handling in a regulated sector, or compliance ops in fintech, insurtech, or health

 - Communicate with precision and adapt to your audience, whether you're briefing a legal expert, aligning with a product team, or coaching a front-line agent. You get buy-in from agents and managers who didn't ask for a new process, and that's as important as designing the process itself

 - Spot simplification opportunities and know how to turn them into projects: you identify what should be automated or redesigned, then drive the collaboration with Care Ops and Product to make it happen

 - Are comfortable navigating regulatory frameworks (GDPR, complaint handling, CNIL) without being a lawyer; you know when to escalate and when to own it, and you're backed by Legal and DPO experts at Alan

 - Are comfortable making judgment calls in ambiguous situations and moving forward without waiting for all the answers.

 - Are fluent in French (C1+ written and spoken,  essential for CNIL notifications, ombudsman responses, and legal correspondence) and proficient in English for internal Alan collaboration
   
   No prior legal qualification is required but a background in law is a genuine plus. We are looking for operational rigor, strong communication, and the appetite to build something that scales.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B-C level range.




🌍 HOW WE WORK

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration.




🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.
